# File Summary

This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format

4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with

- Pay special attention to the Repository Description. These contain important context and guidelines specific to this project.

## File: .github/workflows/appwrite-site-release.yml
````yaml
name: appwrite-site-release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: Prepare an inactive candidate or activate an independently reviewed candidate
        type: choice
        options: [prepare, activate]
        required: true
        default: prepare
      target:
        description: Target environment
        type: choice
        options: [staging, production]
        required: true
        default: staging
      review_artifact_id:
        description: Same-revision artifact containing signed qualification and comparison receipts
        type: string
        required: true
      promote:
        description: Explicitly authorize this production preparation or activation after environment review
        type: boolean
        required: true
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: appwrite-site-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    if: github.repository == 'liangzixuan/cronometer-gold' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/retention-features' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.target == 'staging' || inputs.promote)
    environment: appwrite-${{ inputs.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320 # v4.4.0
        with:
          version: 11.19.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.2
      - name: Install the locked release tools without lifecycle scripts
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Build the checked-in shared evidence serializer
        run: pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/contracts build
      - name: Read only bounded inert review evidence for this exact revision
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REVIEW_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.review_artifact_id }}
          RELEASE_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation }}
          RELEASE_TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/appwrite/review-artifact.py
          --artifact-id "$REVIEW_ARTIFACT_ID" --revision "$GITHUB_SHA"
          --operation "$RELEASE_OPERATION" --target "$RELEASE_TARGET"
          --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/appwrite-review"
      - name: Admit actual current source, jobs, browser run and environment review
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
        run: >-
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/appwrite/github-checks.ts
          --target "$RELEASE_TARGET" --revision "$GITHUB_SHA"
          --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-github-evidence.json"
      - name: Prepare the exact tracked-source archive without artifact execution
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/appwrite/source-artifact.ts prepare --repo . --revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/appwrite-source"
      - name: Verify qualification and perform the selected bounded phase
        id: release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation }}
          RELEASE_TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
          APPWRITE_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.APPWRITE_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          APPWRITE_BACKEND_READINESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.APPWRITE_BACKEND_READINESS_TOKEN }}
          APPWRITE_STAGING_READINESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.APPWRITE_STAGING_READINESS_TOKEN }}
          APPWRITE_SITE_ID: ${{ vars.APPWRITE_SITE_ID }}
          APPWRITE_OTHER_SITE_ID: ${{ vars.APPWRITE_OTHER_SITE_ID }}
          WEB_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${{ vars.WEB_PUBLIC_ORIGIN }}
          API_INTERNAL_URL: ${{ vars.API_INTERNAL_URL }}
          APPWRITE_BUILD_SPECIFICATION: ${{ vars.APPWRITE_BUILD_SPECIFICATION }}
          APPWRITE_RUNTIME_SPECIFICATION: ${{ vars.APPWRITE_RUNTIME_SPECIFICATION }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=("$RELEASE_OPERATION" --target "$RELEASE_TARGET"
            --artifact "$RUNNER_TEMP/appwrite-source"
            --github-evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-github-evidence.json"
            --qualification "$RUNNER_TEMP/appwrite-review/qualification.json"
            --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt.json")
          if [[ "$RELEASE_OPERATION" == "activate" ]]; then
            args+=(--candidate-receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/appwrite-review/candidate-receipt.json")
          fi
          if [[ "$RELEASE_TARGET" == "production" ]]; then
            args+=(--staging-config "$RUNNER_TEMP/appwrite-review/staging-config.json"
              --staging-receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/appwrite-review/staging-receipt.json")
          fi
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/appwrite/site-release.ts "${args[@]}"
      - name: Retain bounded phase receipt for independent review or reconciliation
        if: always() && steps.release.outcome != 'skipped' && steps.release.outcome != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: appwrite-${{ inputs.target }}-${{ inputs.operation }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-receipt.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
````

````yaml
name: browserstack-web
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/retention-features]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  attestations: read
  packages: read
concurrency:

jobs:
  synthetic-browser:

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320 # v4.4.0

      - name: Install locked development dependencies
        run: |
          test "$(pnpm --version)" = "11.19.0"
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --strict-peer-dependencies
      - name: Set up the repository-pinned image inspection tool
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@bb05f3f5519dd87d3ba754cc423b652a5edd6d2c # v4.2.0
        with:

      - name: Bind checkout and prepare pinned browser/image assets
        run: python3 -B scripts/browserstack/ci-run.py prepare
      - name: Verify exact original service image provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 -B scripts/browserstack/ci-run.py admit-images
      - name: Initialize empty fixture vulnerability-ignore policy
        run: install -m 600 /dev/null "${RUNNER_TEMP}/browser-fixture.trivyignore"
      - name: Reject high or critical PostgreSQL fixture vulnerabilities
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        env:
          TRIVY_PLATFORM: linux/arm64

          scanners: vuln
          vuln-type: os,library
          severity: HIGH,CRITICAL
          ignore-unfixed: false
          exit-code: "1"

      - name: Reject high or critical Meilisearch fixture vulnerabilities
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        env:
          TRIVY_PLATFORM: linux/arm64
          TRIVY_IGNOREFILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-fixture.trivyignore
        with:
          version: v0.74.0
          cache: false
          cache-dir: ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-fixture-trivy-cache
          scan-type: image
          image-ref: ghcr.io/liangzixuan/cronometer-gold-meilisearch@sha256:f8e88bf8a95d2e915d5dd408b0f33c2d453d51543931a66869deba69adb99cbe
          scanners: vuln
          vuln-type: os,library
          severity: HIGH,CRITICAL

          exit-code: "1"

        run: |

          python3 -B scripts/browserstack/ci-run.py record-build
      - name: Start the bounded synthetic real app
        timeout-minutes: 11
        run: python3 -B scripts/browserstack/ci-run.py start

      - name: Stop owned tunnel, applications and containers

        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: python3 -B scripts/browserstack/ci-run.py cleanup
      - name: Print the bounded source, browser and cleanup receipt
        if: always()
        run: python3 -B scripts/browserstack/ci-run.py summary
````

````yaml
name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
  push:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  quality:
    name: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@dfe3c3f87815947d99a8997f908cb6525fc44e9e # v4.0.1
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.5.7

      - name: Validate the Azure infrastructure pivot
        run: |
          terraform -chdir=infra/azure init -backend=false -lockfile=readonly
          terraform -chdir=infra/azure fmt -check -recursive
          terraform -chdir=infra/azure validate
          python3 infra/azure/tests/static-contracts.py
          python3 -m unittest discover -s infra/azure/tests -p 'test_*.py'
          python3 infra/azure/files/tests/static-contracts.py

      - name: Validate the separate Azure development empty-host contract
        env:
          TF_DATA_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/nourishing-development-terraform-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          terraform -chdir=infra/development/azure init -backend=false -lockfile=readonly -input=false
          terraform -chdir=infra/development/azure fmt -check
          terraform -chdir=infra/development/azure validate
          python3 -B infra/development/azure/test-contract.py

      - name: Validate the OCI controlled-beta infrastructure
        run: |
          terraform -chdir=infra/oci init -backend=false -lockfile=readonly
          terraform -chdir=infra/oci fmt -check -recursive
          terraform -chdir=infra/oci validate
          python3 infra/oci/tests/static-contracts.py

      - name: Validate the opt-in LocalStack fixture
        run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s infra/localstack/tests -p 'test_*.py'

      - name: Validate the physical-device private-tailnet policy renderer
        run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s infra/tailscale/tests -p 'test_*.py'

      - name: Validate the P0 client-smoke normalizer contracts
        run: python3 -B -m unittest infra.smoke.tests.test_p0_client_smoke

      - name: Prove the synthetic Windows collector producer boundary
        run: python3 -B -m infra.tailscale.tests.windows_install_collector_producer_check

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320 # v4.4.0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:

          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: |
          test "$(pnpm --version)" = "11.19.0"
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --strict-peer-dependencies

      - name: Check manifests, formatting, boundaries, types, and tests
        run: pnpm check

      - name: Build all applications and packages
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Exercise the mobile release readiness state
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ vars.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
          NUTRITION_RELEASE_DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_JSON: ${{ secrets.NUTRITION_RELEASE_DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_JSON }}
        run: pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/mobile ci:release-state

      - name: Reject high-severity production dependency advisories
        run: pnpm audit:prod

      - name: Enforce production license allowlist
        run: pnpm licenses:check

  secrets:
    name: secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install checksum-pinned Gitleaks CLI
        env:
          GITLEAKS_SHA256: 551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
          GITLEAKS_VERSION: 8.30.1
        run: |
          archive="${RUNNER_TEMP}/gitleaks.tar.gz"
          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "${archive}" \
            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
          echo "${GITLEAKS_SHA256}  ${archive}" | sha256sum --check --strict

      - name: Scan committed history for secrets

  database:

        env:

    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320 # v4.4.0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: |
          test "$(pnpm --version)" = "11.19.0"
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --strict-peer-dependencies

      - name: Build integration-test workspace packages
        run: pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/worker... build

      - name: Set up pinned Buildx metadata inspection
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@bb05f3f5519dd87d3ba754cc423b652a5edd6d2c # v4.2.0
        with:

      - name: Install pinned Cosign for the object-store fixture
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@6f9f17788090df1f26f669e9d70d6ae9567deba6 # v4.1.2
        with:
          cosign-release: v3.1.3

      - name: Verify the qualified patched object-store image
        env:

        run: |

      - name: Initialize an empty object-store vulnerability-ignore policy
        run: install -m 600 /dev/null "${RUNNER_TEMP}/object-store.trivyignore"

      - name: Reject high or critical object-store vulnerabilities before execution
        env:

        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0

          scanners: vuln
          vuln-type: os,library

      - name: Prepare private object-store fixture credentials

      - name: Validate local service topology
        run: node scripts/prepare-ci-object-store.mjs prepare

      - name: Bootstrap least-privilege private object storage
        run: |
          docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml -f "${RUNNER_TEMP}/patched-object-store.compose.json" up -d --wait object-store
          node scripts/local-object-store.mjs bootstrap
          node scripts/prepare-ci-object-store.mjs runtime

      - name: Exercise encrypted artifact storage with split credentials
        env:
          RUN_ARTIFACT_STORE_INTEGRATION: "1"

          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_ENDPOINT: http://127.0.0.1:9000

        run: >-
          node node_modules/dotenv-cli/cli.js

      - name: Apply and replay database migrations
        env:

          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_tracker
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/db db:migrate
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/db db:migrate

      - name: Exercise database integration invariants
        env:
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_tracker
        run: pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/db test

      - name: Exercise authenticated API persistence adapters
        env:
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_tracker
        run: pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/api test

      - name: Bootstrap scoped Meilisearch keys
        id: retention_meili_bootstrap
        env:
          MEILI_MASTER_KEY: search-integration-key-20260815
          MEILI_PORT: "7700"
          MEILI_URL: http://127.0.0.1:7700
        run: |
          target="${RUNNER_TEMP}/retention-meili.env"
          node scripts/scoped-meili-keys.mjs --output-file "${target}"
          identity="$(stat --format='%d:%i' -- "${target}")"
          {
            echo "created=true"
            echo "identity=${identity}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Drill retention export and erasure production wiring
        env:
          RUN_RETENTION_WORKER_INTEGRATION: "1"
          POSTGRES_DB: nutrition_tracker
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: nutrition_local_only
          POSTGRES_PORT: "5432"
          POSTGRES_USER: nutrition_local
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_tracker
          OBJECT_STORE_PORT: "9000"
          MEILI_PORT: "7700"
          MEILI_URL: http://127.0.0.1:7700
          EXPORT_ARTIFACT_ENDPOINT: http://127.0.0.1:9000
          EXPORT_ARTIFACT_REGION: us-east-1
          EXPORT_ARTIFACT_BUCKET: nutrition-private-exports
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_ENDPOINT: http://127.0.0.1:9000
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_REGION: us-east-1
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_BUCKET: nutrition-erasure-ledger
        run: >-
          node node_modules/dotenv-cli/cli.js
          -o
          --no-expand
          -e .local-data/object-store/runtime.env
          -e "${RUNNER_TEMP}/retention-meili.env"
          --
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/api test:retention-integration

      - name: Rehearse a complete PostgreSQL backup and isolated restore
        env:
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_BUCKET: nutrition-erasure-ledger
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_CURRENT_KEY_ID: ci-erasure-ledger-v1
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_ENCRYPTION_KEYS: '{"ci-erasure-ledger-v1":"AgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgI="}'
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_ENDPOINT: http://127.0.0.1:9000
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_LOCATOR_CURRENT_KEY_ID: ci-erasure-locator-v1
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_LOCATOR_HMAC_KEYS: '{"ci-erasure-locator-v1":"AwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwM="}'
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_REGION: us-east-1
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_RESTORE_SPOOL_DIR: /dev/shm/nutrition-erasure-restore-ci
        run: |
          node node_modules/dotenv-cli/cli.js -o --no-expand -e .local-data/object-store/runtime.env -- bash -euo pipefail <<'OBJECT_STORE_TEST'
          source_restore_epoch="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
          target_restore_epoch="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
          if [ "${source_restore_epoch}" = "${target_restore_epoch}" ]; then
            echo "Restore epochs unexpectedly matched" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          export DATABASE_SSL_MODE=disable
          export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_tracker
          export DATABASE_RESTORE_EPOCH="${source_restore_epoch}"
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/worker erasure:restore-replay
          container_id="$(docker ps --filter publish=5432 --quiet)"
          if [ -z "${container_id}" ] || [ "$(printf '%s\n' "${container_id}" | wc -l)" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "Expected exactly one PostgreSQL service container on port 5432" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          node scripts/postgres-restore-drill.mjs \
            --container "${container_id}" \
            --connect-allowlist nutrition_local \
            --dump-directory /dev/shm \
            --dump-protection tmpfs \
            --expected-owner nutrition_local \
            --source-db nutrition_tracker \
            --target-db nutrition_restore_ci_retention \
            --user nutrition_local
          export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_restore_ci_retention
          export DATABASE_RESTORE_EPOCH="${target_restore_epoch}"
          if pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/worker database:readiness-probe; then
            echo "Restored database became ready before erasure-ledger replay" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/worker erasure:restore-replay
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/worker database:readiness-probe
          TEST_DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL}" pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/api test
          OBJECT_STORE_TEST

      - name: Exercise live erasure-ledger replay and API/worker readiness
        env:
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_BUCKET: nutrition-erasure-ledger
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_ENDPOINT: http://127.0.0.1:9000
          ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_REGION: us-east-1
          RUN_RETENTION_RESTORE_INTEGRATION: "1"
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_tracker
        run: |
          node node_modules/dotenv-cli/cli.js -o --no-expand -e .local-data/object-store/runtime.env -- bash -euo pipefail <<'OBJECT_STORE_TEST'
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/worker exec vitest run src/erasure-ledger-restore.integration.test.ts
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/api exec vitest run test/restore-readiness.integration.test.ts
          OBJECT_STORE_TEST

      - name: Exercise PostgreSQL-to-Meilisearch worker boundary
        env:
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nutrition_local:nutrition_local_only@127.0.0.1:5432/nutrition_tracker
          TEST_MEILI_URL: http://127.0.0.1:7700
        run: >-
          node node_modules/dotenv-cli/cli.js
          -o
          --no-expand
          -e "${RUNNER_TEMP}/retention-meili.env"
          --
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/worker test:integration

      - name: Exercise real search index rebuild and queries
        env:
          TEST_MEILI_URL: http://127.0.0.1:7700
        run: >-
          node node_modules/dotenv-cli/cli.js
          -o
          --no-expand
          -e "${RUNNER_TEMP}/retention-meili.env"
          --
          pnpm --filter @nutrition-tracker/search test:integration

      - name: Remove scoped Meilisearch key file
        if: always()
        env:
          RETENTION_MEILI_CREATED: ${{ steps.retention_meili_bootstrap.outputs.created }}
          RETENTION_MEILI_IDENTITY: ${{ steps.retention_meili_bootstrap.outputs.identity }}
        run: |
          target="${RUNNER_TEMP}/retention-meili.env"
          if [ "${RETENTION_MEILI_CREATED}" != "true" ] || [ ! -e "${target}" ]; then
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ -L "${target}" ] || [ ! -f "${target}" ]; then
            echo "Refusing to remove replaced scoped Meilisearch key path" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          identity="$(stat --format='%d:%i' -- "${target}")"
          links="$(stat --format='%h' -- "${target}")"
          if [ "${identity}" != "${RETENTION_MEILI_IDENTITY}" ] || [ "${links}" != "1" ]; then
            echo "Refusing to remove replaced scoped Meilisearch key file" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          rm -f -- "${target}"

      - name: Stop and remove the owned CI object-store fixture
        if: always()
        run: |
          test "${GITHUB_ACTIONS}" = true
          cleanup_status=0
          docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml down --volumes --timeout 10 || cleanup_status=$?
          node scripts/local-object-store.mjs cleanup || cleanup_status=$?
          exit "${cleanup_status}"
````

## File: .github/workflows/container-supply-chain.yml
````yaml
name: container supply chain

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: container-supply-chain-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build-node-runtime:
    name: build, scan, publish (node-runtime)
    if: github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      attestations: write # Record the scanned runtime digest in GitHub's attestation store.
      contents: read # Check out source and the exact upstream Node tag without repository credentials.
      id-token: write # Issue the short-lived identity used to sign the attestation.
      packages: write # Push digest-only content, the commit tag, and registry attestation to GHCR.
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.export.outputs.digest }}
      ref: ${{ steps.export.outputs.ref }}
    env:
      NODE_SOURCE_BUILD_IMAGE: docker.io/library/python:3.12.14-bookworm@sha256:80f5d259a5969c86f6c92145d572de4a68c68e0edd28d4367dec0fb411b42af3
      NODE_SOURCE_BUILD_ARM64_DIGEST: sha256:b6e215e1d3d8787fe1e0f1507c7d2418b16fe19acef77cf971b2d965570ced41
      NODE_CPP_RUNTIME_SOURCE_IMAGE: gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian13:nonroot@sha256:939d6f1671529d230f50b563578e9b5d206af58f038b10ebd7e1233023d4e167
      NODE_CPP_RUNTIME_SOURCE_ARM64_DIGEST: sha256:806e2fa26e3cec196e986cb206f44f07070d211c028389c79091fd440cb75882
      NODE_RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE: gcr.io/distroless/base-nossl-debian13:nonroot@sha256:86554c46a420d507ff2d678fd261ab8691fba4875a20302f38a49e684b42a33f
      NODE_RUNTIME_BASE_ARM64_DIGEST: sha256:ab7e729cfe775ce5f251b2d28b45e88b70e0582cdbadd1aa1f99a41601f11f3b
      NODE_RELEASE_FINGERPRINT: CC68F5A3106FF448322E48ED27F5E38D5B0A215F
      NODE_RELEASE_SIGNER_SHA256: e31e1aa40a8331f01d753cef475f7b9eab934fc25f5f0b36995bfd80bd66ad27
      NODE_RELEASE_TAG_OBJECT: 490a9fef8f8adcda5a95bd6f96035b05cb43fe5b
      NODE_RELEASE_COMMIT: aa4c77582be995286fc6e00aaf530dc7ade102a9
      NODE_SOURCE_SHA256: bbe768df8d5815d7fa76124052985332452e0a4742d39f32027550d1aab8f6fb
      NODE_SHASUMS_SHA256: 778ac5b2fcdbd68d9c0ae9f4310674faa3af0910bd0d18e7f6597787c40a3e39
      NODE_SHASUMS_SIGNATURE_SHA256: 169f1452c14cd653247408352f1534b9f31e3d13f9c6399c3977368095e11eda
      OPENSSL_FIX_COMMIT: 08e7756c3900bcfd77a720e7b74e27d6e4ed01a9
      OPENSSL_FIX_PATCH_SHA256: 3b4f3ff1e9d26ca3dd75f6d98cc5d30c7dbfc03892e4bc0037a7e14bec8c5087
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check out the signed Node release tag
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          path: .upstream/node
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: v22.23.2
          repository: nodejs/node

      - name: Verify native ARM64 execution
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${RUNNER_ARCH}" = ARM64
          test "$(uname -m)" = aarch64

      - name: Verify the signed Node source and exact OpenSSL fix
        env:
          KEY_FILE: infra/docker/node-release-CC68F5A3106FF448322E48ED27F5E38D5B0A215F.asc
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-release"
          keyring_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-release-keyring"
          install -d -m 0700 "${release_dir}" "${keyring_dir}"

          test "$(sha256sum "${KEY_FILE}" | awk '{ print $1 }')" = "${NODE_RELEASE_SIGNER_SHA256}"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "${release_dir}/release-key.asc" \
            https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/release-keys/43d7b8e5d41e87a3721d416f14fb86a68aeec1ce/keys/CC68F5A3106FF448322E48ED27F5E38D5B0A215F.asc
          test "$(sha256sum "${release_dir}/release-key.asc" | awk '{ print $1 }')" = "${NODE_RELEASE_SIGNER_SHA256}"
          cmp "${KEY_FILE}" "${release_dir}/release-key.asc"
          test "$(gpg --batch --with-colons --import-options show-only --import "${KEY_FILE}" | awk -F: '$1 == "pub" { count++ } END { print count + 0 }')" = 1
          test "$(gpg --batch --with-colons --import-options show-only --import "${KEY_FILE}" | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10; exit }')" = "${NODE_RELEASE_FINGERPRINT}"
          gpg --batch --homedir "${keyring_dir}" --import "${KEY_FILE}"

          test "$(git -C .upstream/node rev-parse refs/tags/v22.23.2)" = "${NODE_RELEASE_TAG_OBJECT}"
          test "$(git -C .upstream/node rev-parse 'refs/tags/v22.23.2^{}')" = "${NODE_RELEASE_COMMIT}"
          GNUPGHOME="${keyring_dir}" git -C .upstream/node -c gpg.program=gpg verify-tag v22.23.2

          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "${release_dir}/SHASUMS256.txt" \
            https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/SHASUMS256.txt
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "${release_dir}/SHASUMS256.txt.sig" \
            https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/SHASUMS256.txt.sig
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "${release_dir}/node-v22.23.2.tar.xz" \
            https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/node-v22.23.2.tar.xz
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "${release_dir}/CVE-2026-14456.patch" \
            "https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/${OPENSSL_FIX_COMMIT}.patch"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "${release_dir}/openssl-advisory.txt" \
            https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260813.txt

          test "$(sha256sum "${release_dir}/SHASUMS256.txt" | awk '{ print $1 }')" = "${NODE_SHASUMS_SHA256}"
          test "$(sha256sum "${release_dir}/SHASUMS256.txt.sig" | awk '{ print $1 }')" = "${NODE_SHASUMS_SIGNATURE_SHA256}"
          test "$(sha256sum "${release_dir}/node-v22.23.2.tar.xz" | awk '{ print $1 }')" = "${NODE_SOURCE_SHA256}"
          test "$(sha256sum "${release_dir}/CVE-2026-14456.patch" | awk '{ print $1 }')" = "${OPENSSL_FIX_PATCH_SHA256}"

          status_file="${release_dir}/signature.status"
          gpgv --keyring "${keyring_dir}/pubring.kbx" --status-fd 1 \
            "${release_dir}/SHASUMS256.txt.sig" \
            "${release_dir}/SHASUMS256.txt" > "${status_file}"
          test "$(awk '$1 == "[GNUPG:]" && $2 == "VALIDSIG" { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' "${status_file}")" = 1
          test "$(awk '$1 == "[GNUPG:]" && $2 == "VALIDSIG" { print $3 ":" $12 }' "${status_file}")" = "${NODE_RELEASE_FINGERPRINT}:${NODE_RELEASE_FINGERPRINT}"

          expected_checksum="${NODE_SOURCE_SHA256}  node-v22.23.2.tar.xz"
          test "$(grep -Fxc "${expected_checksum}" "${release_dir}/SHASUMS256.txt")" = 1
          (cd "${release_dir}" && grep -Fx "${expected_checksum}" SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum --check --strict -)
          test "$(sed -n '1s/^From \([0-9a-f]\{40\}\) .*$/\1/p' "${release_dir}/CVE-2026-14456.patch")" = "${OPENSSL_FIX_COMMIT}"
          grep -Fq 'CVE-2026-14456' "${release_dir}/openssl-advisory.txt"
          grep -Fq 'and 08e7756 (for 3.5)' "${release_dir}/openssl-advisory.txt"
          sed -n 's#^diff --git a/\([^ ]*\) b/.*#\1#p' "${release_dir}/CVE-2026-14456.patch" > "${release_dir}/patch-paths.actual"
          diff -u - "${release_dir}/patch-paths.actual" <<'EOF'
          doc/man3/SSL_get_value_uint.pod
          include/internal/quic_port.h
          include/openssl/ssl.h.in
          ssl/quic/quic_impl.c
          ssl/quic/quic_port.c
          ssl/quic/quic_port_local.h
          util/other.syms
          EOF

      - name: Set up pinned Buildx and BuildKit
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@bb05f3f5519dd87d3ba754cc423b652a5edd6d2c # v4.2.0
        with:
          version: v0.36.1
          driver-opts: image=moby/buildkit@sha256:28a898719c18a33f4e8000685287fa36fd0dd9560c6440227d3a732d79bb41d8
          cache-binary: false

      - name: Install Cosign for Distroless verification
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@6f9f17788090df1f26f669e9d70d6ae9567deba6 # v4.1.2
        with:
          cosign-release: v3.1.3

      - name: Verify pinned builder and signed Distroless inputs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          verify_arm64_index() {
            local name="$1"
            local ref="$2"
            local arm64_digest="$3"
            local index_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${name}-index.json"

            docker buildx imagetools inspect "${ref}" --raw > "${index_file}"
            jq -e --arg arm64_digest "${arm64_digest}" '
              .schemaVersion == 2 and
              .mediaType == "application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json" and
              ([.manifests[] | select(
                .platform.os == "linux" and
                .platform.architecture == "arm64" and
                (.platform.variant == null or .platform.variant == "v8")
              )] | length == 1) and
              ([.manifests[] | select(
                .platform.os == "linux" and
                .platform.architecture == "arm64" and
                (.platform.variant == null or .platform.variant == "v8")
              )][0].digest == $arm64_digest)
            ' "${index_file}" >/dev/null
          }

          verify_distroless_index() {
            local name="$1"
            local ref="$2"
            local arm64_digest="$3"
            local verification_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${name}-cosign-verification.json"

            cosign verify \
              --certificate-oidc-issuer https://accounts.google.com \
              --certificate-identity keyless@distroless.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
              --output json \
              "${ref}" > "${verification_file}"
            jq -e 'type == "array" and length > 0' "${verification_file}" >/dev/null
            verify_arm64_index "${name}" "${ref}" "${arm64_digest}"
          }

          verify_arm64_index node-source-builder "${NODE_SOURCE_BUILD_IMAGE}" "${NODE_SOURCE_BUILD_ARM64_DIGEST}"
          verify_distroless_index node-cpp-runtime-source "${NODE_CPP_RUNTIME_SOURCE_IMAGE}" "${NODE_CPP_RUNTIME_SOURCE_ARM64_DIGEST}"
          verify_distroless_index node-runtime-base "${NODE_RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE}" "${NODE_RUNTIME_BASE_ARM64_DIGEST}"

      - name: Resolve lowercase GHCR image name
        id: image
        env:
          IMAGE_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          IMAGE_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          owner_lower="$(printf '%s' "${IMAGE_OWNER}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          repository_lower="$(printf '%s' "${IMAGE_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          printf 'name=ghcr.io/%s/%s-node-runtime\n' "${owner_lower}" "${repository_lower}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Log in to GHCR with the job token
        uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4.6.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Resolve an existing immutable commit tag
        id: existing
        env:
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          published_ref="${IMAGE}:sha-${REVISION}"
          inspect_error="${RUNNER_TEMP}/existing-manifest-error.txt"

          if existing_manifest="$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "${published_ref}" --format '{{json .Manifest}}' 2>"${inspect_error}")"; then
            existing_digest="$(printf '%s' "${existing_manifest}" | jq -er '.digest | select(test("^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"))')"
            printf 'exists=true\n' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
            printf 'digest=%s\n' "${existing_digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          else
            if ! grep -Eiq 'manifest unknown|not found' "${inspect_error}"; then
              echo "Could not safely determine whether ${published_ref} exists." >&2
              sed -n '1,20p' "${inspect_error}" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            printf 'exists=false\n' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          fi

      - name: Build and push patched Node runtime by digest
        id: build
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        uses: docker/build-push-action@53b7df96c91f9c12dcc8a07bcb9ccacbed38856a # v7.3.0
        with:
          context: .
          file: infra/docker/node-runtime.Dockerfile
          target: runtime
          platforms: linux/arm64
          pull: true
          build-args: |
            NODE_SOURCE_BUILD_IMAGE=${{ env.NODE_SOURCE_BUILD_IMAGE }}
            NODE_CPP_RUNTIME_SOURCE_IMAGE=${{ env.NODE_CPP_RUNTIME_SOURCE_IMAGE }}
            NODE_RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE=${{ env.NODE_RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}
            org.opencontainers.image.title=${{ github.event.repository.name }}-node-runtime
            org.opencontainers.image.version=sha-${{ github.sha }}
          outputs: type=image,name=${{ steps.image.outputs.name }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true
          provenance: mode=max,version=v1
          sbom: generator=docker.io/docker/buildkit-syft-scanner@sha256:79e7b013cbec16bbb436f312819a49a4a57752b2270c1a9332ae1a10fcc82a68

      - name: Select the patched runtime candidate digest
        id: candidate
        env:
          BUILT_DIGEST: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
          EXISTING_DIGEST: ${{ steps.existing.outputs.digest }}
          EXISTING_TAG: ${{ steps.existing.outputs.exists }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${EXISTING_TAG}" = true ]; then
            digest="${EXISTING_DIGEST}"
          else
            digest="${BUILT_DIGEST}"
          fi
          [[ "${digest}" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || {
            echo 'Patched runtime candidate digest is missing or malformed.' >&2
            exit 1
          }
          printf 'digest=%s\n' "${digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'ref=%s@%s\n' "${IMAGE}" "${digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Verify patched runtime identity, binary, and symbols
        env:
          IMAGE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.ref }}
          REPOSITORY_NAME: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
          SOURCE: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          index_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-runtime-candidate-index.json"
          image_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-runtime-candidate-image.json"
          docker buildx imagetools inspect "${IMAGE_REF}" --raw > "${index_file}"
          runtime_digest="$(node scripts/verify-oci-buildkit-attestations.mjs \
            --index "${index_file}" \
            --image-ref "${IMAGE_REF}")"
          runtime_ref="${IMAGE_REF%@*}@${runtime_digest}"
          docker pull --platform linux/arm64 "${runtime_ref}" >/dev/null
          docker image inspect "${runtime_ref}" --format '{{json .}}' | \
            jq '{os: .Os, architecture: .Architecture, config: .Config}' > "${image_file}"

          jq -e \
            --arg revision "${REVISION}" \
            --arg source "${SOURCE}" \
            --arg title "${REPOSITORY_NAME}-node-runtime" \
            --arg version "sha-${REVISION}" '
              .os == "linux" and
              .architecture == "arm64" and
              .config.User == "65532:65532" and
              .config.Entrypoint == null and
              .config.Cmd == ["/nodejs/bin/node"] and
              .config.Shell == null and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.revision"] == $revision and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.source"] == $source and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.title"] == $title and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.version"] == $version and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.runtime.component"] == "node-runtime" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.runtime.contract"] == "patched-node22.23.2-openssl3.5.7-08e7756-base-nossl-debian13-arm64" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.version"] == "22.23.2" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source"] == "https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/node-v22.23.2.tar.xz" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.sha256"] == "bbe768df8d5815d7fa76124052985332452e0a4742d39f32027550d1aab8f6fb" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.manifest.sha256"] == "778ac5b2fcdbd68d9c0ae9f4310674faa3af0910bd0d18e7f6597787c40a3e39" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.manifest.signature.sha256"] == "169f1452c14cd653247408352f1534b9f31e3d13f9c6399c3977368095e11eda" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.signature.fingerprint"] == "CC68F5A3106FF448322E48ED27F5E38D5B0A215F" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.tag-object"] == "490a9fef8f8adcda5a95bd6f96035b05cb43fe5b" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.commit"] == "aa4c77582be995286fc6e00aaf530dc7ade102a9" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.signer.source.commit"] == "43d7b8e5d41e87a3721d416f14fb86a68aeec1ce" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.signer.material.sha256"] == "e31e1aa40a8331f01d753cef475f7b9eab934fc25f5f0b36995bfd80bd66ad27" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.version"] == "3.5.7" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.cve"] == "CVE-2026-14456" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.advisory"] == "https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260813.txt" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.commit"] == "08e7756c3900bcfd77a720e7b74e27d6e4ed01a9" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.patch.sha256"] == "3b4f3ff1e9d26ca3dd75f6d98cc5d30c7dbfc03892e4bc0037a7e14bec8c5087" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.builder.image"] == "docker.io/library/python:3.12.14-bookworm" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.builder.image.digest"] == "sha256:80f5d259a5969c86f6c92145d572de4a68c68e0edd28d4367dec0fb411b42af3" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.builder.image.arm64.digest"] == "sha256:b6e215e1d3d8787fe1e0f1507c7d2418b16fe19acef77cf971b2d965570ced41" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.cxx.image"] == "gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian13:nonroot" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.cxx.image.digest"] == "sha256:939d6f1671529d230f50b563578e9b5d206af58f038b10ebd7e1233023d4e167" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.cxx.image.arm64.digest"] == "sha256:806e2fa26e3cec196e986cb206f44f07070d211c028389c79091fd440cb75882" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.base.image"] == "gcr.io/distroless/base-nossl-debian13:nonroot" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.base.image.digest"] == "sha256:86554c46a420d507ff2d678fd261ab8691fba4875a20302f38a49e684b42a33f" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.base.image.arm64.digest"] == "sha256:ab7e729cfe775ce5f251b2d28b45e88b70e0582cdbadd1aa1f99a41601f11f3b" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.distroless.signature.identity"] == "keyless@distroless.iam.gserviceaccount.com" and
              .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.distroless.signature.issuer"] == "https://accounts.google.com" and
              (.config.Env | index("PATH=/nodejs/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin")) != null and
              (.config.Env | index("SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt")) != null
            ' "${image_file}" >/dev/null

          docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --read-only --cap-drop ALL \
            --entrypoint /nodejs/bin/node "${runtime_ref}" -e '
              const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
              const fs = require("node:fs");
              const tls = require("node:tls");
              assert.equal(process.version, "v22.23.2");
              assert.equal(process.platform, "linux");
              assert.equal(process.arch, "arm64");
              assert.equal(process.versions.openssl, "3.5.7");
              assert.equal(process.config.variables.node_shared_openssl, false);
              assert.equal(process.config.variables.openssl_quic, false);
              assert.equal(process.allowedNodeEnvironmentFlags.has("--experimental-quic"), false);
              assert.equal(require("node:module").builtinModules.includes("quic"), false);
              assert.equal(process.getuid(), 65532);
              assert.equal(process.getgid(), 65532);
              assert.equal(fs.existsSync(process.env.SSL_CERT_FILE), true);
              const certificateBundle = fs.readFileSync(process.env.SSL_CERT_FILE, "utf8");
              assert.match(certificateBundle, /-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----/);
              tls.createSecureContext({ ca: certificateBundle });
              assert.equal(fs.statSync("/usr/share/zoneinfo/America/Chicago").isFile(), true);
              const chicago = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
                timeZone: "America/Chicago",
                hour: "2-digit",
                hourCycle: "h23",
                timeZoneName: "shortOffset",
              });
              const coordinate = (instant) => Object.fromEntries(
                chicago.formatToParts(new Date(instant)).map((part) => [part.type, part.value]),
              );
              assert.deepEqual(
                { hour: coordinate("2026-01-15T12:00:00Z").hour,
                  zone: coordinate("2026-01-15T12:00:00Z").timeZoneName },
                { hour: "06", zone: "GMT-6" },
              );
              assert.deepEqual(
                { hour: coordinate("2026-07-15T12:00:00Z").hour,
                  zone: coordinate("2026-07-15T12:00:00Z").timeZoneName },
                { hour: "07", zone: "GMT-5" },
              );
              for (const path of ["/bin/sh", "/usr/bin/npm", "/nodejs/bin/npm"]) {
                assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path), false, `${path} must not ship`);
              }
            '

          binary="${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-v22.23.2-patched"
          extraction_container="node-runtime-extract-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          trap 'docker rm --force "${extraction_container}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
          docker create --platform linux/arm64 --name "${extraction_container}" "${runtime_ref}" >/dev/null
          docker cp "${extraction_container}:/nodejs/bin/node" "${binary}"
          docker rm "${extraction_container}" >/dev/null
          trap - EXIT
          test "$(nm -D "${binary}" | awk '$3 == "OSSL_QUIC_server_method" { count++ } END { print count + 0 }')" = 1
          test "$(nm -D "${binary}" | awk '$3 == "ossl_quic_port_get_max_pending_channels" { count++ } END { print count + 0 }')" = 1
          test "$(nm -D "${binary}" | awk '$3 == "ossl_quic_port_set_max_pending_channels" { count++ } END { print count + 0 }')" = 1
          readelf -h "${binary}" | grep -Eq 'Machine:[[:space:]]+AArch64'
          readelf -d "${binary}" | sed -n 's/.*Shared library: \[\([^]]*\)\]/\1/p' | sort > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-needed.actual"
          printf '%s\n' ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 libc.so.6 libgcc_s.so.1 libm.so.6 libstdc++.so.6 | sort > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-needed.expected"
          diff -u "${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-needed.expected" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-needed.actual"
          if grep -Eq '^lib(ssl|crypto)' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-needed.actual"; then
            echo 'The patched Node binary unexpectedly links shared OpenSSL libraries.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          test "$(readelf -l "${binary}" | sed -n 's/.*Requesting program interpreter: \([^]]*\)\].*/\1/p')" = /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1

      - name: Initialize an explicit empty vulnerability-ignore policy
        run: install -m 600 /dev/null "${RUNNER_TEMP}/empty.trivyignore"

      - name: Fail closed on patched runtime high or critical vulnerabilities
        env:
          TRIVY_PLATFORM: linux/arm64
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        with:
          version: v0.74.0
          scan-type: image
          image-ref: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.ref }}
          scanners: vuln
          vuln-type: os,library
          severity: HIGH,CRITICAL
          ignore-unfixed: false
          trivyignores: ${{ runner.temp }}/empty.trivyignore
          exit-code: "1"
          format: table
          hide-progress: true
          timeout: 15m
          cache: false

      - name: Inventory patched runtime packages with Trivy
        env:
          TRIVY_PLATFORM: linux/arm64
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        with:
          version: v0.74.0
          skip-setup-trivy: true
          scan-type: image
          image-ref: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.ref }}
          scanners: vuln
          vuln-type: os,library
          severity: UNKNOWN,LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL
          ignore-unfixed: false
          trivyignores: ${{ runner.temp }}/empty.trivyignore
          list-all-pkgs: true
          exit-code: "0"
          format: json
          output: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-runtime-trivy-inventory.json
          hide-progress: true
          timeout: 15m
          cache: false

      - name: Assert patched runtime inventory
        env:
          INVENTORY_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-runtime-trivy-inventory.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq -e '
            def package($name): any(.Results[]?.Packages[]?; .Name == $name);
            package("gcc-14-base") and
            package("libgcc-s1") and
            package("libstdc++6") and
            (package("libssl3t64") | not) and
            (package("libssl3") | not) and
            (package("openssl") | not) and
            (any(.Results[]?.Vulnerabilities[]?; .VulnerabilityID == "CVE-2026-14456") | not)
          ' "${INVENTORY_FILE}" >/dev/null

      - name: Record GitHub build provenance
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.digest }}
          push-to-registry: true

      - name: Verify GitHub build provenance
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.digest }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if gh attestation verify "oci://${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}" \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
              --signer-workflow "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/.github/workflows/container-supply-chain.yml" \
              --signer-digest "${GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA}" \
              --source-digest "${REVISION}" \
              --source-ref "${GITHUB_REF}" \
              --predicate-type 'https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1' \
              --deny-self-hosted-runners; then
              exit 0
            fi
            [ "${attempt}" -lt 5 ] || break
            sleep 5
          done
          echo 'The patched runtime digest has no matching trusted build-provenance attestation.' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Create the immutable commit tag
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker buildx imagetools create --tag "${IMAGE}:sha-${REVISION}" "${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}"

      - name: Verify the immutable commit tag
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          published_manifest="$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "${IMAGE}:sha-${REVISION}" --format '{{json .Manifest}}')"
          published_digest="$(printf '%s' "${published_manifest}" | jq -er '.digest | select(test("^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"))')"
          test "${published_digest}" = "${DIGEST}"

      - name: Summarize the verified patched runtime
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          {
            printf "### node-runtime container\n\n"
            printf -- "- Tag: \`%s:sha-%s\`\n" "${IMAGE}" "${REVISION}"
            printf -- "- Digest: \`%s\`\n" "${DIGEST}"
            printf -- "- Platform: \`linux/arm64\` (native build)\n"
            printf -- "- Node/OpenSSL: \`v22.23.2 / 3.5.7 + 08e7756\`\n"
            printf -- "- Deployment: intermediate runtime only; not deployed directly\n"
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

      - name: Export the verified patched Node runtime
        id: export
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "${DIGEST}" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
          printf 'digest=%s\n' "${DIGEST}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'ref=%s@%s\n' "${IMAGE}" "${DIGEST}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  build-scan-publish-apps:
    name: build, scan, publish (${{ matrix.component }})
    if: github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch
    needs: build-node-runtime
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      attestations: write # Record the scanned image digest in GitHub's attestation store.
      contents: read # Check out the source commit without persisting credentials.
      id-token: write # Issue the short-lived identity used to sign the attestation.
      packages: write # Push digest-only content, the commit tag, and registry attestation to GHCR.
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - component: api
            dockerfile: infra/docker/api.Dockerfile
          - component: worker
            dockerfile: infra/docker/worker.Dockerfile
          - component: migrator
            dockerfile: infra/docker/migrator.Dockerfile
          - component: web
            dockerfile: infra/docker/web.Dockerfile
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Resolve lowercase GHCR image name
        id: image
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          IMAGE_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          IMAGE_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          owner_lower="$(printf '%s' "${IMAGE_OWNER}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          repository_lower="$(printf '%s' "${IMAGE_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          printf 'name=ghcr.io/%s/%s-%s\n' "${owner_lower}" "${repository_lower}" "${COMPONENT}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Install ARM64 emulator
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@96fe6ef7f33517b61c61be40b68a1882f3264fb8 # v4.2.0
        with:
          image: docker.io/tonistiigi/binfmt@sha256:400a4873b838d1b89194d982c45e5fb3cda4593fbfd7e08a02e76b03b21166f0
          platforms: arm64
          cache-image: false

      - name: Set up pinned Buildx and BuildKit
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@bb05f3f5519dd87d3ba754cc423b652a5edd6d2c # v4.2.0
        with:
          version: v0.36.1
          driver-opts: image=moby/buildkit@sha256:28a898719c18a33f4e8000685287fa36fd0dd9560c6440227d3a732d79bb41d8
          cache-binary: false

      - name: Log in to GHCR with the job token
        uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4.6.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Resolve an existing immutable commit tag
        id: existing
        env:
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          published_ref="${IMAGE}:sha-${REVISION}"
          inspect_error="${RUNNER_TEMP}/existing-manifest-error.txt"

          if existing_manifest="$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "${published_ref}" --format '{{json .Manifest}}' 2>"${inspect_error}")"; then
            existing_digest="$(printf '%s' "${existing_manifest}" | jq -er '.digest | select(test("^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"))')"
            printf 'exists=true\n' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
            printf 'digest=%s\n' "${existing_digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          else
            if ! grep -Eiq 'manifest unknown|not found' "${inspect_error}"; then
              echo "Could not safely determine whether ${published_ref} exists." >&2
              sed -n '1,20p' "${inspect_error}" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            printf 'exists=false\n' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          fi

      - name: Build and push by digest with SBOM and provenance
        id: build
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        uses: docker/build-push-action@53b7df96c91f9c12dcc8a07bcb9ccacbed38856a # v7.3.0
        with:
          context: .
          file: ${{ matrix.dockerfile }}
          target: runtime
          platforms: linux/arm64
          pull: true
          build-args: |
            NODE_RUNTIME_IMAGE=${{ needs.build-node-runtime.outputs.ref }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}
            org.opencontainers.image.title=${{ github.event.repository.name }}-${{ matrix.component }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=sha-${{ github.sha }}
          outputs: type=image,name=${{ steps.image.outputs.name }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true
          provenance: mode=max,version=v1
          sbom: generator=docker.io/docker/buildkit-syft-scanner@sha256:79e7b013cbec16bbb436f312819a49a4a57752b2270c1a9332ae1a10fcc82a68

      - name: Select the candidate digest
        id: candidate
        env:
          BUILT_DIGEST: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
          EXISTING_DIGEST: ${{ steps.existing.outputs.digest }}
          EXISTING_TAG: ${{ steps.existing.outputs.exists }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${EXISTING_TAG}" = 'true' ]; then
            digest="${EXISTING_DIGEST}"
          else
            digest="${BUILT_DIGEST}"
          fi
          [[ "${digest}" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || {
            echo 'Candidate image digest is missing or malformed.' >&2
            exit 1
          }
          printf 'digest=%s\n' "${digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'ref=%s@%s\n' "${IMAGE}" "${digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Verify ARM64 runtime identity
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          IMAGE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.ref }}
          NODE_RUNTIME_REF: ${{ needs.build-node-runtime.outputs.ref }}
          REPOSITORY_NAME: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
          SOURCE: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          index_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-index.json"
          image_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-image.json"
          docker buildx imagetools inspect "${IMAGE_REF}" --raw > "${index_file}"
          runtime_digest="$(node scripts/verify-oci-buildkit-attestations.mjs \
            --index "${index_file}" \
            --image-ref "${IMAGE_REF}")"
          runtime_ref="${IMAGE_REF%@*}@${runtime_digest}"
          for pull_attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if docker pull --platform linux/arm64 "${runtime_ref}" >/dev/null; then
              break
            fi
            [ "${pull_attempt}" -lt 5 ] || {
              echo "Could not pull the exact ARM64 child after ${pull_attempt} attempts." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            sleep "$((pull_attempt * 2))"
          done
          docker image inspect "${runtime_ref}" --format '{{json .}}' | \
            jq '{os: .Os, architecture: .Architecture, config: .Config}' > "${image_file}"

          jq -e \
            --arg revision "${REVISION}" \
            --arg source "${SOURCE}" \
            --arg title "${REPOSITORY_NAME}-${COMPONENT}" \
            --arg version "sha-${REVISION}" '
              .os == "linux" and
              .architecture == "arm64" and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.revision"] == $revision and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.source"] == $source and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.title"] == $title and
              .config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.version"] == $version
            ' "${image_file}" >/dev/null

          case "${COMPONENT}" in
            api|worker|migrator|web)
              jq -e --arg component "${COMPONENT}" --arg node_runtime_ref "${NODE_RUNTIME_REF}" '
                .config.User == "1000:1000" and
                .config.Entrypoint == null and
                .config.WorkingDir == "/app" and
                .config.Volumes == null and
                .config.StopSignal == null and
                .config.Shell == null and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.runtime.component"] == $component and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.runtime.contract"] == "patched-node22.23.2-openssl3.5.7-08e7756-base-nossl-debian13-uid-gid-1000-empty-entrypoint" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node-runtime.ref"] == $node_runtime_ref and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source"] == "https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/node-v22.23.2.tar.xz" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.sha256"] == "bbe768df8d5815d7fa76124052985332452e0a4742d39f32027550d1aab8f6fb" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.manifest.sha256"] == "778ac5b2fcdbd68d9c0ae9f4310674faa3af0910bd0d18e7f6597787c40a3e39" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.manifest.signature.sha256"] == "169f1452c14cd653247408352f1534b9f31e3d13f9c6399c3977368095e11eda" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.source.signature.fingerprint"] == "CC68F5A3106FF448322E48ED27F5E38D5B0A215F" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.tag-object"] == "490a9fef8f8adcda5a95bd6f96035b05cb43fe5b" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.commit"] == "aa4c77582be995286fc6e00aaf530dc7ade102a9" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.signer.source.commit"] == "43d7b8e5d41e87a3721d416f14fb86a68aeec1ce" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.release.signer.material.sha256"] == "e31e1aa40a8331f01d753cef475f7b9eab934fc25f5f0b36995bfd80bd66ad27" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.builder.image"] == "docker.io/library/python:3.12.14-bookworm" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.builder.image.digest"] == "sha256:80f5d259a5969c86f6c92145d572de4a68c68e0edd28d4367dec0fb411b42af3" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.builder.image.arm64.digest"] == "sha256:b6e215e1d3d8787fe1e0f1507c7d2418b16fe19acef77cf971b2d965570ced41" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.cxx.image"] == "gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian13:nonroot" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.cxx.image.digest"] == "sha256:939d6f1671529d230f50b563578e9b5d206af58f038b10ebd7e1233023d4e167" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.cxx.image.arm64.digest"] == "sha256:806e2fa26e3cec196e986cb206f44f07070d211c028389c79091fd440cb75882" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.base.image"] == "gcr.io/distroless/base-nossl-debian13:nonroot" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.base.image.digest"] == "sha256:86554c46a420d507ff2d678fd261ab8691fba4875a20302f38a49e684b42a33f" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.base.image.arm64.digest"] == "sha256:ab7e729cfe775ce5f251b2d28b45e88b70e0582cdbadd1aa1f99a41601f11f3b" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.node.version"] == "22.23.2" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.version"] == "3.5.7" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.cve"] == "CVE-2026-14456" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.advisory"] == "https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260813.txt" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.commit"] == "08e7756c3900bcfd77a720e7b74e27d6e4ed01a9" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.openssl.fix.patch.sha256"] == "3b4f3ff1e9d26ca3dd75f6d98cc5d30c7dbfc03892e4bc0037a7e14bec8c5087" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.distroless.signature.identity"] == "keyless@distroless.iam.gserviceaccount.com" and
                .config.Labels["io.cronometer.upstream.distroless.signature.issuer"] == "https://accounts.google.com"
              ' "${image_file}" >/dev/null
              ;;
          esac

          case "${COMPONENT}" in
            api)
              api_healthcheck="fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + (process.env.API_PORT || '3001') + '/ready').then((response) => { if (!response.ok) process.exit(1) }).catch(() => process.exit(1))"
              jq -e --arg healthcheck "${api_healthcheck}" '
                .config.Cmd == ["/nodejs/bin/node", "--enable-source-maps", "dist/server.js"] and
                .config.ExposedPorts == {"3001/tcp": {}} and
                (.config.Env | sort) == ([
                  "API_HOST=0.0.0.0",
                  "API_PORT=3001",
                  "HOME=/home/node",
                  "NODE_ENV=production",
                  "PATH=/nodejs/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin",
                  "SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
                ] | sort) and
                .config.Healthcheck.Test == ["CMD", "/nodejs/bin/node", "-e", $healthcheck] and
                .config.Healthcheck.Interval == 30000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.Timeout == 5000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.StartPeriod == 30000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.Retries == 3
              ' "${image_file}" >/dev/null
              ;;
            worker)
              jq -e '
                .config.Cmd == ["/nodejs/bin/node", "--enable-source-maps", "dist/index.js"] and
                .config.ExposedPorts == null and
                (.config.Env | sort) == ([
                  "HOME=/home/node",
                  "NODE_ENV=production",
                  "PATH=/nodejs/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin",
                  "SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
                ] | sort) and
                .config.Healthcheck.Test == ["CMD", "/nodejs/bin/node", "dist/database-readiness-probe.js"] and
                .config.Healthcheck.Interval == 60000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.Timeout == 10000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.StartPeriod == 30000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.Retries == 3
              ' "${image_file}" >/dev/null
              ;;
            migrator)
              jq -e '
                .config.Cmd == ["/nodejs/bin/node", "--enable-source-maps", "dist/cli.js"] and
                .config.ExposedPorts == null and
                (.config.Env | sort) == ([
                  "HOME=/home/node",
                  "NODE_ENV=production",
                  "PATH=/nodejs/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin",
                  "SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
                ] | sort) and
                .config.Healthcheck == {"Test": ["NONE"]}
              ' "${image_file}" >/dev/null
              ;;
            web)
              web_healthcheck="fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + (process.env.PORT || '3000') + '/').then((response) => { if (!response.ok) process.exit(1) }).catch(() => process.exit(1))"
              jq -e --arg healthcheck "${web_healthcheck}" '
                .config.Cmd == ["/nodejs/bin/node", "apps/web/server.js"] and
                .config.ExposedPorts == {"3000/tcp": {}} and
                (.config.Env | sort) == ([
                  "HOME=/home/node",
                  "HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0",
                  "NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1",
                  "NODE_ENV=production",
                  "PATH=/nodejs/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin",
                  "PORT=3000",
                  "SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
                ] | sort) and
                .config.Healthcheck.Test == ["CMD", "/nodejs/bin/node", "-e", $healthcheck] and
                .config.Healthcheck.Interval == 30000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.Timeout == 5000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.StartPeriod == 30000000000 and
                .config.Healthcheck.Retries == 3
              ' "${image_file}" >/dev/null
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Initialize an explicit empty vulnerability-ignore policy
        run: install -m 600 /dev/null "${RUNNER_TEMP}/empty.trivyignore"

      - name: Fail closed on high or critical vulnerabilities
        env:
          TRIVY_PLATFORM: linux/arm64
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        with:
          version: v0.74.0
          scan-type: image
          image-ref: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.ref }}
          scanners: vuln
          vuln-type: os,library
          severity: HIGH,CRITICAL
          ignore-unfixed: false
          trivyignores: ${{ runner.temp }}/empty.trivyignore
          exit-code: "1"
          format: table
          hide-progress: true
          timeout: 15m
          cache: false

      - name: Inventory exact application packages with Trivy
        if: matrix.component == 'api' || matrix.component == 'worker' || matrix.component == 'migrator' || matrix.component == 'web'
        env:
          TRIVY_PLATFORM: linux/arm64
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        with:
          version: v0.74.0
          skip-setup-trivy: true
          scan-type: image
          image-ref: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.ref }}
          scanners: vuln
          vuln-type: os,library
          severity: UNKNOWN,LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL
          ignore-unfixed: false
          trivyignores: ${{ runner.temp }}/empty.trivyignore
          list-all-pkgs: true
          exit-code: "0"
          format: json
          output: ${{ runner.temp }}/candidate-trivy-inventory.json
          hide-progress: true
          timeout: 15m
          cache: false

      - name: Assert scanner visibility of exact application packages
        if: matrix.component == 'api' || matrix.component == 'worker' || matrix.component == 'migrator' || matrix.component == 'web'
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          INVENTORY_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/candidate-trivy-inventory.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq -e --arg component "${COMPONENT}" '
            def package($name; $version):
              any(.Results[]?.Packages[]?; .Name == $name and .Version == $version);
            (any(.Results[]?.Packages[]?; .Name == "libssl3t64" or .Name == "libssl3") | not) and
            (any(.Results[]?.Vulnerabilities[]?; .VulnerabilityID == "CVE-2026-14456") | not) and
            (if $component == "api" then
              package("fastify"; "5.12.2") and
              package("zod"; "4.4.3") and
              package("pg"; "8.23.0")
            elif $component == "worker" then
              package("zod"; "4.4.3") and
              package("pg"; "8.23.0")
            elif $component == "migrator" then
              package("dotenv"; "17.4.2") and
              package("kysely"; "0.29.5") and
              package("pg"; "8.23.0")
            elif $component == "web" then
              package("next"; "16.3.6") and
              package("react"; "19.2.3") and
              package("react-dom"; "19.2.3") and
              package("sharp"; "0.35.4") and
              package("@img/sharp-linux-arm64"; "0.35.4")
            else false
            end)
          ' "${INVENTORY_FILE}" >/dev/null

      - name: Exercise the distroless Node runtime contract
        if: matrix.component == 'api' || matrix.component == 'worker' || matrix.component == 'migrator' || matrix.component == 'web'
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          IMAGE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          test "$(docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 \
            --entrypoint node "${IMAGE_REF}" --version)" = 'v22.23.2'
          docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --read-only --cap-drop ALL \
            --env COMPONENT="${COMPONENT}" \
            --tmpfs /tmp:uid=1000,gid=1000,mode=1770 \
            --entrypoint /nodejs/bin/node "${IMAGE_REF}" -e '
              const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
              const fs = require("node:fs");
              const os = require("node:os");
              const tls = require("node:tls");
              assert.equal(process.version, "v22.23.2");
              assert.equal(process.versions.openssl, "3.5.7");
              assert.equal(process.config.variables.node_shared_openssl, false);
              assert.equal(process.config.variables.openssl_quic, false);
              assert.equal(process.allowedNodeEnvironmentFlags.has("--experimental-quic"), false);
              assert.equal(require("node:module").builtinModules.includes("quic"), false);
              assert.equal(process.getuid(), 1000);
              assert.equal(process.getgid(), 1000);
              const user = os.userInfo();
              assert.equal(user.uid, 1000);
              assert.equal(user.gid, 1000);
              assert.equal(user.username, "node");
              assert.equal(user.homedir, "/home/node");
              assert.equal(user.shell, "/sbin/nologin");
              assert.equal(process.env.HOME, "/home/node");
              assert.equal(process.env.PATH.split(":")[0], "/nodejs/bin");
              assert.equal(process.env.SSL_CERT_FILE, "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt");
              assert.equal(fs.statSync(process.env.SSL_CERT_FILE).isFile(), true);
              const certificateBundle = fs.readFileSync(process.env.SSL_CERT_FILE, "utf8");
              assert.match(certificateBundle, /-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----/);
              tls.createSecureContext({ ca: certificateBundle });
              assert.equal(
                fs.statSync("/usr/share/zoneinfo/America/Chicago").isFile(),
                true,
              );
              assert.equal(
                new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: "America/Chicago" })
                  .resolvedOptions().timeZone,
                "America/Chicago",
              );
              const chicago = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
                timeZone: "America/Chicago",
                hour: "2-digit",
                minute: "2-digit",
                hourCycle: "h23",
                timeZoneName: "shortOffset",
              });
              const coordinate = (instant) => Object.fromEntries(
                chicago.formatToParts(new Date(instant)).map((part) => [part.type, part.value]),
              );
              assert.deepEqual(
                { hour: coordinate("2026-01-15T12:00:00Z").hour,
                  zone: coordinate("2026-01-15T12:00:00Z").timeZoneName },
                { hour: "06", zone: "GMT-6" },
              );
              assert.deepEqual(
                { hour: coordinate("2026-07-15T12:00:00Z").hour,
                  zone: coordinate("2026-07-15T12:00:00Z").timeZoneName },
                { hour: "07", zone: "GMT-5" },
              );
              assert.ok(tls.rootCertificates.length > 0);
              const temporary = `/tmp/runtime-contract-${process.pid}`;
              fs.writeFileSync(temporary, "ready", { mode: 0o600 });
              assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(temporary, "utf8"), "ready");
              fs.unlinkSync(temporary);
              const readOnlyParent = process.env.COMPONENT === "web" ? "/app/apps/web" : "/app/dist";
              const parent = fs.statSync(readOnlyParent);
              assert.equal(parent.uid, 1000);
              assert.equal(parent.gid, 1000);
              assert.notEqual(parent.mode & 0o200, 0);
              assert.throws(
                () => fs.writeFileSync(`${readOnlyParent}/.read-only-contract`, "blocked"),
                (error) => error?.code === "EROFS",
              );
              for (const path of ["/bin/sh", "/usr/bin/npm", "/usr/local/bin/npm", "/nodejs/bin/npm"]) {
                assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path), false, `${path} must not ship`);
              }
              assert.throws(() => require.resolve("npm"));
            '

          case "${COMPONENT}" in
            api)
              entrypoint=dist/server.js
              ;;
            worker)
              entrypoint=dist/index.js
              ;;
            migrator)
              entrypoint=dist/cli.js
              ;;
            web)
              entrypoint=apps/web/server.js
              ;;
          esac
          docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --read-only --cap-drop ALL \
            --tmpfs /tmp:uid=1000,gid=1000,mode=1770 \
            --entrypoint /nodejs/bin/node "${IMAGE_REF}" --check "${entrypoint}"

          case "${COMPONENT}" in
            api)
              docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --read-only --cap-drop ALL \
                --tmpfs /tmp:uid=1000,gid=1000,mode=1770 \
                --entrypoint /nodejs/bin/node "${IMAGE_REF}" -e '
                  Promise.all([
                    import("@nutrition-tracker/db"),
                    import("fastify"),
                    import("zod"),
                  ]).catch((error) => {
                    console.error(error);
                    process.exit(1);
                  });
                '
              ;;
            worker)
              docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --read-only --cap-drop ALL \
                --tmpfs /tmp:uid=1000,gid=1000,mode=1770 \
                --entrypoint /nodejs/bin/node "${IMAGE_REF}" -e '
                  Promise.all([
````
