````css
  --paper: #fbf9f5;
  --paper-deep: #f1ece4;
  --forest: #ad3f26;
  --lime: #eef0e5;
  --line: #e5e1dc;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --calm-green: #4f7145;
  --calm-coral: #e38c72;
  --calm-gold: #dfa72e;
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper);
  font-size: 1rem;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Nourishing Icons";
  src: url("/fonts/fa-solid-900.woff2") format("woff2");
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-display: block;
}
.appIcon {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1.15em;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-family: "Nourishing Icons", sans-serif;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}
.shell :is(h1, h2, h3) {
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}
.shell h2 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.shell h3 {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.shell :is(a, button, input, select, textarea, summary):focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--calm-green);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.shell :is(button, input, select, textarea, .buttonPrimary, .secondaryAction) {
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.shell button {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.shell :is(input, select, textarea) {
  max-width: 100%;
}
.shell .sidebar {
  position: relative;
  top: auto;
  height: auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 12px clamp(20px, 2.3vw, 56px);
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--paper);
  overflow: visible;
  z-index: 10;
}
.shell .sidebar .brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.shell .sidebar .brand > span:not(.appIcon) {
  color: inherit;
}
.shell .sidebar .brand .appIcon {
  color: var(--calm-green);
  font-size: 1.65rem;
}
.shell .sidebar nav {
  overflow: visible;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  justify-content: center;
}
.shell .sidebar nav a,
.shell .appNavMore > summary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  color: var(--ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.shell .sidebar nav .appIcon {
  padding: 0;
  color: inherit;
  font-size: 1.1em;
}
.shell .sidebar nav a:hover,
.shell .appNavMore > summary:hover {
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
.shell .sidebar nav a[aria-current="page"],
.shell .appNavMoreActive {
  background: var(--lime);
  color: #224a35;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.appNavPrimary {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.appNavMore {
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.appNavMore > summary {
  list-style: none;
}
.appNavMore > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.appNavMorePanel,
.shell .ledgerAccountPanel {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 20;
  right: 0;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  width: 250px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
  padding: 12px;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px #291e1814;
}
.shell .appNavMorePanel a {
  display: flex;
  white-space: normal;
}
.shell .ledgerAccount {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.shell .ledgerAccount > summary {
  padding: 11px 12px;
  min-height: 44px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.shell .ledgerAccountPanel {
  padding: 18px;
}
.shell .sidebar .accountIdentity {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .sidebar .verificationLink {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.shell .sidebar .wellnessNote {
  margin: 14px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.shell .sidebar .signOutButton {
  margin-top: 12px;
}
.shell .dashboard {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1800px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: 28px clamp(16px, 2.3vw, 40px) 48px;
}
.shell .foodDashboard {
  max-width: 1180px;
}
.shell .recipesDashboard,
.shell .goalsDashboard,
.shell .retentionDashboard {
  max-width: 1240px;
}
.shell .hydrationDashboard,
.shell .activityDashboard {
  max-width: 1120px;
}
@media (min-width: 761px) {
  .shell .goalWorkspace {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(280px, 0.55fr);
  }
}
.shell .dashboardHeader {
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.shell .dashboardHeader h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 2.9vw, 2.7rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}
.shell .kicker {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.shell .statusPill {
  color: #665440;
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: none;
}
.shell .ledgerToolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.shell .ledgerToolbar .dashboardHeader {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .dateNavigator {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  align-items: stretch;
  margin: 0;
  gap: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.shell .dateNavigator :is(button, input) {
  min-height: 44px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.shell .dateNavigator :is(button, input) + button,
.shell .dateNavigator input {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shell .dateNavigator :is(button, input):focus-visible {
  outline-offset: -3px;
}
.shell .dateNavigator button:first-of-type {
  border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px;
}
.shell .dateNavigator button:last-child {
  border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0;
}
.shell .dateNavigator button {
  padding: 8px 10px;
}
.shell .dateNavigator input {
  width: 148px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 8px;
  color-scheme: light;
}
.shell .ledgerToolbar .buttonPrimary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 48px;
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 10px 24px;
  color: white;
  background: var(--forest);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.shell .diaryStatus {
  margin: 8px 0 14px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}
.shell .diaryStatus:empty {
  display: none;
}
.shell .diaryDashboard .kicker {
  display: none;
}
.shell .ledgerWorkspace {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) clamp(300px, 30%, 420px);
  align-items: start;
  gap: 20px;
}
.shell .ledgerWorkspace > * {
  min-width: 0;
}
.shell .ledgerWorkspace .diaryGrid {
  display: block;
}
.shell .ledgerRail {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.shell .dailySummary {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.shell .dailySummaryHeading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.shell .dailySummaryHeading h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
}
.shell .dailySummaryHeading p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}
.shell .diaryDashboard .dailySummaryHeading {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
}
.shell .dailySummaryGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.2fr repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .dailySummaryCard {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 0 0 16px;
  border: 0;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.shell .dailySummaryCard:first-child {
  border-left: 0;
  padding-left: 0;
}
.shell .dailySummaryCard dt {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  margin: 0 0 3px;
}
.shell .dailySummaryCard dd {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .dailySummaryValue {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
  line-height: 1.3;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .dailySummaryQualification,
.shell .dailySummaryNote {
  display: block;
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.shell .dailySummaryNote {
  margin-top: 12px;
}
.shell .ledgerTableHead {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) clamp(108px, 24%, 210px) 90px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  gap: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.shell .ledgerContent .diaryPageCount {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}
.shell .ledgerContent > .buttonQuiet {
  display: block;
  margin: 0 0 8px auto;
  min-height: 40px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.shell .mealSection {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--white);
  overflow: visible;
}
.shell .mealHeading {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: #f4f2eb;
  min-height: 48px;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
}
.shell .mealHeading h2 {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.shell .mealHeading .buttonQuiet {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  min-height: 36px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.shell .mealHeading a {
  color: var(--forest);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
.shell .mealBody,
.shell .mealEntries {
  min-width: 0;
}
.shell .mealSection ul {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .mealSection li {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shell .mealSection .diaryEntry {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) clamp(108px, 24%, 210px) 90px;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 4px 12px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 12px 0 4px;
}
.shell .ledgerRowName h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .ledgerRowName > p {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  margin: 4px 0;
}
.shell .ledgerRowPortion {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .ledgerRowEnergy {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: right;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .ledgerRowActions {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: end;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-right: 40px;
}
.shell .ledgerRowActions button {
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--forest);
  background: transparent;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.shell .ledgerMore {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.shell .ledgerMore > summary {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 4px;
  right: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 40px;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 6px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.shell .ledgerMore > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.shell .ledgerMore > summary > span:not(.appIcon) {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
}
.shell .ledgerMore > summary:hover {
  color: var(--forest);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
.shell .ledgerMore[open] > summary {
  position: static;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.shell .ledgerMoreContent {
  padding: 14px;
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.shell .ledgerEntryEvidence {
  display: grid;
  gap: 5px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.shell .ledgerMore .entryActions {
  padding: 10px 0;
}
.shell .mealSection .entryNutrients {
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.shell .entryNutrients summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 32px;
}
.shell .mealSection .entryEditor {
  padding: 16px 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.shell .emptyMeal {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.shell .mealFooter {
  padding: 4px 16px 12px;
}
.shell .mealAddFood {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  color: var(--forest);
  min-height: 36px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.shell .mealActions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
}
.shell .diaryGroupSettingsLauncher {
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.shell .ledgerRail .nutritionSummary {
  position: static;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.shell .nutritionSummary h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
}
.shell .ledgerPanelHeading {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}
.shell .ledgerPanelHeading a {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--forest);
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
.shell .nutritionSummary dl {
  margin-top: 16px;
}
.shell .nutrientTotal {
  padding: 11px 0;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.shell .nutrientTotal dd {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .nutrientTotal small {
  max-width: 185px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}
.shell .totalsNote {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}
.shell .ledgerOtherNutrients {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.shell .ledgerOtherNutrients summary {
  color: var(--forest);
  min-height: 36px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.shell .nutritionSummary .ledgerSavedTargets {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  color: var(--forest);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.shell .todayOverviewGrid {
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .todayOverviewCard {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.shell .todayOverviewCard h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .todayOverviewMetric strong {
  font-size: 1.6rem;
}
.shell .todayOverviewBody p {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.shell .ledgerRail .todayOverview,
.shell .ledgerRail .todayOverviewGrid {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .ledgerRail .todayOverviewHeading {
  display: none;
}
.shell .ledgerRail .todayOverviewGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
}
.shell .ledgerRail .todayOverviewCard {
  padding: 18px;
}
.shell .todayOverviewCard header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px;
}
.shell .todayOverviewCard header a {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--forest);
}
.shell .todayOverviewBody {
  min-height: 0;
  margin-top: 12px;
}
.shell .diaryGroupSettings {
  min-width: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.shell .ledgerRail .diaryGroupSettings {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shell .diaryGroupSettings h2 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
}
.shell .diaryGroupSettings :is(p, label) {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.shell .diaryGroupSettings textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 90px;
  padding: 12px;
  resize: vertical;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  font: inherit;
}
.shell .ledgerDayNoteHelp {
  margin: 10px 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.shell .ledgerDayNoteHelp summary {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.shell .emptyDiary {
  margin: 24px 0;
  padding: 24px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.shell .emptyDiary h2 {
  font-size: 1.7rem;
}
.shell .foodIntro {
  max-width: 68ch;
  font-size: 1rem;
}
.shell .foodTools {
  margin-top: 24px;
  gap: 24px;
}
.shell .foodSearchPanel,
.shell .barcodePanel {
  padding: 24px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.shell .foodPanelHeading h2,
.shell .barcodePanel h2 {
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.shell .foodPanelHeading > p {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.shell .diaryContext {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .shell .sidebar {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 10px 20px;
  }
  .shell .sidebar nav {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 2;
    justify-content: start;
  }
  .shell .ledgerAccount {
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
  }
  .shell .mealSection .diaryEntry {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 90px;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowName {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowPortion {
    grid-column: 1;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowEnergy {
    grid-column: 2;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .shell .ledgerWorkspace {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .shell .ledgerRail {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .shell .ledgerRail .nutritionSummary {
    grid-row: span 2;
  }
  .shell .mealSection .diaryEntry {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) clamp(108px, 24%, 210px) 90px;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowName,
  .shell .ledgerRowPortion,
  .shell .ledgerRowEnergy {
    grid-column: auto;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .shell .sidebar {
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }
  .shell .sidebar .brand {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }
  .shell .sidebar nav a,
  .shell .appNavMore > summary {
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }
  .shell .sidebar nav a {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .shell .appNavMorePanel a {
    flex-direction: row;
  }
  .shell .dashboard {
    padding: 22px 16px 40px;
  }
  .shell .dashboardHeader {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .shell .ledgerToolbar {
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .shell .ledgerToolbar .dashboardHeader {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .shell .ledgerToolbar .buttonPrimary {
    margin-left: 0;
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .shell .dailySummaryGrid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 18px;
  }
  .shell .dailySummaryCard:nth-child(odd) {
    padding-left: 0;
    border-left: 0;
  }
  .shell .mealSection .diaryEntry {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowName {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowPortion {
    grid-column: 1;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowEnergy {
    grid-column: 2;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRail {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRail .nutritionSummary {
    grid-row: auto;
  }
  .shell .ledgerTableHead {
    display: none;
  }
  .shell .ledgerRowActions button,
  .shell .ledgerMore > summary {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
  .shell .entryEditor {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .shell .sidebar {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .shell .sidebar .brand {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
  }
  .shell .ledgerAccount > summary {
    padding: 10px 4px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }
  .shell .dashboard {
    padding: 20px 12px 36px;
  }
  .shell .dateNavigator input {
    width: 146px;
  }
  .shell .dateNavigator button {
    padding: 8px 10px;
  }
  .shell .appNavMore > summary {
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 10px 6px;
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }
}

/* Keep the date controls and report metadata secondary to the intake chart. */
.shell .reportControls {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 18px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.shell .reportDateFields {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(150px, 220px)) max-content;
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.shell .reportRangeError:empty {
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .reportDashboard > .reportPresets {
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.shell .reportPrintControls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px 16px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}
.shell .reportPrintControls p {
  flex: 1 1 360px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}
.shell .reportWorkspace {
  margin-top: 20px;
  gap: 20px;
}
.shell .reportOverview,
.shell .reportPanel {
  padding: 22px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.shell .reportOverview {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1fr) minmax(420px, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--white);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--forest);
}
.shell .reportOverview h2,
.shell .reportPanel h2 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}
.shell .reportOverview p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.shell .reportStats {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  background: transparent;
}
.shell .reportStats div {
  padding: 10px 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.shell .reportStats dt {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}
.shell .reportStats dd {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
}
.shell .reportChart {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .shell .reportDateFields {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .shell .reportDateFields input {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .shell .reportDateFields .buttonPrimary {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .shell .reportOverview {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .shell .reportPanelHeading {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 14px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .shell .reportOverview,
  .shell .reportPanel {
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .shell .reportStats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 4px 16px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .shell .reportDateFields {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Put search first and keep each result's serving controls with that food. */
.shell .foodSearchForm {
  margin-top: 20px;
}
.shell .foodSearchForm .intentFieldset {
  margin: 14px 0 0;
}
.shell .foodSearchPanel > .quickAddControls {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.shell .foodResultList article {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(130px, 0.45fr);
  gap: 12px 20px;
  padding: 20px 0;
}
.shell .foodResultList .sourceCopy {
  max-width: none;
  align-content: start;
}
.shell .foodAddArea {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.shell .foodAddArea .quickAddControls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(80px, 120px) minmax(150px, auto);
  align-items: end;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 14px;
  gap: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.shell .foodAddArea .quickAddControls label,
.shell .foodAddArea .quickAddControls :is(input, select) {
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.shell .foodAddArea .quickAddControls label:first-of-type {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
}
.shell .foodAddArea .quickAddControls label:nth-of-type(2) {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1;
}
.shell .foodAddArea .quickAddControls small {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  grid-row: 2;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.shell .foodAddArea .quickAddButton {
  grid-column: 3;
  grid-row: 1;
  justify-self: stretch;
  min-height: 44px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--white);
  background: var(--forest);
  border-color: var(--forest);
}
.shell .foodAddConfirmation {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.shell .foodAddConfirmation p {
  margin: 12px 0 8px;
}
.shell .foodAddConfirmation .secondaryAction {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  color: var(--forest);
  background: var(--white);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.shell .barcodeResult .foodAddArea {
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.shell .barcodeResult .quickAddControls {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 90px;
}
.shell .barcodeResult .quickAddButton {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  grid-row: 3;
}

@media (max-width: 1400px) {
  .shell .foodAddArea .quickAddControls {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 80px;
  }
  .shell .foodAddArea .quickAddButton {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 3;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .shell .foodTools {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .shell .barcodePanel {
    position: static;
  }
  .shell .foodPanelHeading {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: start;
    gap: 8px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .shell .foodSearchPanel,
  .shell .barcodePanel {
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .shell .foodResultList article {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .shell .foodResultList .sourceCopy {
    text-align: left;
  }
}

/* Dashboard composition. Native progress visuals are driven only by saved targets. */
.shell .calmOverview {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
}
.shell .calmSummary,
.shell .calmMeals,
.shell .calmSnapshot {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 22px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.shell .calmSummaryHeading {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
}
.shell .calmSummaryHeading h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
}
.shell .calmSummaryHeading > span {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}
.shell .calmSummaryBody {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(350px, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr);
  gap: 32px;
  align-items: center;
}
.shell .calmEnergy {
  min-width: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, 1fr) minmax(90px, 0.6fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px 12px;
  text-align: center;
}
.shell .calmEnergyGraphic {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 230px;
  height: 230px;
  max-width: 100%;
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  justify-self: center;
}
.shell .calmEnergyGraphic--untracked {
  height: 180px;
}
.shell .calmEnergyRing {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 8;
}
.shell .calmEnergyRingTrack {
  stroke: #e8e9e2;
}
.shell .calmEnergyRingValue {
  stroke: var(--calm-green);
  stroke-linecap: round;
}
.shell .calmEnergyValue {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  max-width: 86%;
}
.shell .calmEnergyValue > span {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}
.shell .calmEnergyValue strong {
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.8vw, 1.8rem);
  line-height: 1.2;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.shell .nutrientIcon {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
}
.shell .nutrientIcon img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
}
.shell .calmEnergyValue .nutrientIcon {
  color: #b64c30;
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.shell .calmEnergy > .calmProgressTrack {
  display: none;
}
.shell .calmMacros {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 32px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shell .calmMacroRow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 135px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 0;
  align-items: center;
}
.shell .calmMacroRow + .calmMacroRow {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shell .calmMacroRow dt {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}
.shell .calmMacroRow dd {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.shell .calmMacroMetric {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 4px 6px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.shell .calmMacroMetric strong {
  color: var(--ink);
}
.shell .calmMacroRow strong {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .calmQualification {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.shell .calmTarget {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  margin: 7px 0 3px;
}
.shell .calmProgressTrack {
  width: 100%;
  height: 12px;
  margin: 7px 0 4px;
  background: #ededeb;
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.shell .calmProgressTrack > span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--calm-green);
  border-radius: inherit;
}
.shell [data-nutrient="carbohydrate"] .calmProgressTrack > span,
.shell [data-nutrient="calcium"] .calmProgressTrack > span {
  background: var(--calm-coral);
}
.shell [data-nutrient="fat"] .calmProgressTrack > span,
.shell [data-nutrient="iron"] .calmProgressTrack > span {
  background: var(--calm-gold);
}
.shell .calmProgressLabel {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.shell .calmSummaryFooter {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px 18px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
}
.shell .calmSummaryFooter p {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .calmSummaryFooter a {
  color: var(--forest);
}
.shell .calmSummaryFooter button {
  min-height: 36px;
}
.shell .calmOverviewGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.shell .calmCardHeading {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.shell .calmCardHeading h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.shell .calmCardHeading > a {
  color: var(--forest);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 6px 0;
}
.shell .calmCardHeading .appIcon {
  margin-left: 5px;
}
.shell .calmMealCoverage {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}
.shell .calmMealList {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .calmMealRow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(90px, auto) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shell .calmMealIcon {
  color: var(--calm-green);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
}
.shell .calmMealDescription {
  min-width: 0;
}
.shell .calmMealDescription h3 {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.shell .calmMealDescription p {
  margin: 4px 0;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .calmMealDescription small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.shell .calmMealEnergy {
  max-width: 150px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  text-align: right;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.shell .calmMealAdd {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 64px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  gap: 5px;
  color: var(--forest);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.shell .calmMealAdd:hover {
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
.shell .calmSnapshot {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.shell .calmSnapshot dl {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(75px, 0.45fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow dt {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow dd {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px 10px;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow strong {
  font-weight: 400;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.shell .calmCardFooter {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: auto;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 10px;
  color: #244631;
  background: var(--lime);
  border-radius: 6px;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: center;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  align-items: start;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport > * {
  min-width: 0;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverview {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewHeading {
  display: none;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewGrid {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewCard {
  padding: 18px 20px;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewBody {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewMetric {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewBody p {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
}
.shell .calmOverviewSupport .diaryGroupSettings {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.overviewQuickLinks {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}
.shell .overviewQuickLinks a {
  color: var(--forest);
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
}
@media (min-width: 1800px) {
  .shell .calmSummaryBody {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1.3fr);
    gap: 48px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacros {
    padding-left: 48px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacroRow {
    grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .shell .calmEnergyGraphic {
    width: 250px;
    height: 250px;
  }
  .shell .calmEnergyGraphic--untracked {
    height: 195px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .shell .calmSummaryBody {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 0.65fr) minmax(0, 1.35fr);
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacros {
    padding-left: 20px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacroRow {
    grid-template-columns: 115px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .shell .calmOverviewGrid,
  .shell .calmOverviewSupport {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .shell .calmMealRow {
    grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .shell .calmMealDescription {
    grid-column: 2;
  }
  .shell .calmMealEnergy {
    grid-column: 2;
    text-align: left;
    max-width: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  .shell .calmMealAdd {
    grid-column: 3;
    grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .shell .calmOverviewGrid,
  .shell .calmOverviewSupport {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .shell .calmSummaryBody {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacros {
    padding: 0;
    border-left: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .shell .calmEnergyGraphic {
    width: 215px;
    height: 215px;
  }
  .shell .calmEnergyGraphic--untracked {
    height: 145px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacroRow {
    grid-template-columns: 145px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .shell .calmMealRow {
    grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(90px, auto) auto;
  }
  .shell .calmMealEnergy,
  .shell .calmMealAdd {
    grid-column: auto;
    grid-row: auto;
  }
  .shell .calmMealEnergy {
    text-align: right;
  }
  .shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewGrid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .shell .calmSummary,
  .shell .calmMeals,
  .shell .calmSnapshot {
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .shell .calmSummaryHeading {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .shell .calmMacroRow {
    grid-template-columns: 108px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacroRow dt {
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  .shell .nutrientIcon {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
  }
  .shell .calmMacroRow strong {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .shell .calmCardHeading h2 {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }
  .shell .calmMealRow {
    grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .shell .calmMealEnergy {
    grid-column: 2;
    text-align: left;
  }
  .shell .calmMealAdd {
    grid-column: 3;
    grid-row: 1 / span 2;
    min-width: 36px;
  }
  .shell .calmMealIcon {
    font-size: 1.35rem;
  }
  .shell .calmMealDescription h3 {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .shell .calmMealDescription p {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }
  .shell .calmSnapshotRow {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(65px, 0.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .shell .calmOverviewSupport .todayOverviewGrid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.shell .calmEnergyRemaining {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 12px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-weight: 600;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.shell .overviewDashboard .kicker {
  display: none;
}
.shell .calmMacros h3 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
}
.shell .calmMacros dl {
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow .calmProgressTrack {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 3;
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow .calmProgressLabel {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 3;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow .calmTarget {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  grid-row: 2;
  margin: 0;
}
.shell .calmSnapshotRow .calmQualification {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.shell :is(.calmMacroRow, .calmSnapshotRow)[data-exact="true"] .calmQualification {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
}
````

## File: apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx
````typescript
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import Script from "next/script";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT } from "../lib/email-verification";
import { PASSWORD_RECOVERY_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT } from "../lib/password-recovery";
import "./styles.css";
import "./daily-theme.css";

// Per-request CSP nonces require request-time rendering so every Next script receives the nonce.
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Nourishing",
  description: "Provenance-first nutrition tracking",
};

export default async function RootLayout({ children }: Readonly<{ children: ReactNode }>) {
  const nonce = (await headers()).get("x-nonce") ?? undefined;
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        {children}
        <Script
          id="email-verification-fragment-bootstrap"
          nonce={nonce}
          strategy="beforeInteractive"
        >
          {EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT}
        </Script>
        <Script
          id="password-recovery-fragment-bootstrap"
          nonce={nonce}
          strategy="beforeInteractive"
        >
          {PASSWORD_RECOVERY_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT}
        </Script>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
````

````css
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.searchInputRow input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 12px 15px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 33, 29, 0.3);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font: inherit;
}

.searchInputRow input::placeholder {
  color: #77827c;
}

.searchButton,
.barcodeButton,
.loadMoreButton {
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  color: var(--white);
  background: var(--forest);
  border: 1px solid var(--forest);
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.searchButton:disabled,
.barcodeButton:disabled,
.loadMoreButton:disabled {
  cursor: wait;
  opacity: 0.62;
}

.suggestionPanel {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 5;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 33, 29, 0.26);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(20, 60, 47, 0.15);
}

.suggestionPanel > p {
  padding: 14px 16px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.suggestionPanel ul,
.foodResultList {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.suggestionPanel li + li {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.suggestionPanel button {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 54px;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}

.suggestionPanel button:hover {
  background: var(--paper);
}

.suggestionPanel button span {
  font-weight: 750;
}

.sourceCopy small,
.barcodeResult small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.suggestionPanel button small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.searchStatus,
.barcodeStatus {
  min-height: 24px;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

.searchStatus--error,
.barcodeStatus--error {
  color: #8a332b;
}

.foodResultList {
  margin-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.foodResultList > li {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.foodResultList article {
  padding: 21px 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 24px;
}

.resultMain h3,
.barcodeResult h3 {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  font-size: 1.16rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.foodBrand,
.servingCopy {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
}

.foodBrand {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.servingCopy {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.foodKind {
  padding: 4px 7px;
  display: inline-block;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.foodKind--generic {
  color: #245a3a;
  background: #dcefd8;
}

.foodKind--branded {
  color: #6b4c00;
  background: #f7e6b0;
}

.sourceCopy {
  max-width: 180px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
  align-content: center;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}

.loadMoreButton {
  margin-top: 24px;
  color: var(--forest);
  background: transparent;
}

.barcodeForm {
  margin-top: 28px;
}

.barcodePanel .searchInputRow {
  display: grid;
}

.barcodeResult {
  padding: 18px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.barcodeResult p {
  margin: 4px 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.authPage {
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 28px clamp(24px, 6vw, 88px) 72px;
}

.authCard {
  width: min(520px, 100%);
  padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
  margin: clamp(48px, 8vw, 100px) auto 0;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 22px;
}

.authCard h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 4.8rem);
  letter-spacing: -0.06em;
  line-height: 0.95;
}

.authTabs {
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 28px;
  border: 0;
}

.authTabs button,
.signOutButton,
.dateNavigator button,
.secondaryAction,
.entryActions button,
.quickAddButton {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  color: var(--forest);
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 9px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.authTabs button[aria-pressed="true"] {
  color: var(--white);
  background: var(--forest);
  border-color: var(--forest);
}

.authCard form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
  margin-top: 28px;
}

.authCard form input,
.entryEditor input,
.entryEditor textarea,
.entryEditor select,
.quickAddControls input,
.quickAddControls select,
.dateNavigator input {
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 33, 29, 0.3);
  border-radius: 9px;
  font: inherit;
}

.authCard form label:not(:first-child) {
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.authCard form small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.authSubmit {
  min-height: 50px;
  margin-top: 22px;
  color: var(--white);
  background: var(--forest);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.authStatus,
.privacyCopy,
.diaryStatus,
.addStatus {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.authStatus--error,
.diaryStatus--error,
.addStatus--error {
  color: #8a332b;
}

.privacyCopy {
  margin: 22px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.verificationCard .authStatus {
  margin-top: 24px;
}

.verificationResend {
  width: 100%;
}

.verificationActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 24px;
}

.recoveryActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 24px;
}

.recoveryCard > .authStatus {
  margin-top: 24px;
}

.recoveryFieldError {
  margin: 7px 0 0;
  color: #8a332b;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.recoveryLink {
  width: fit-content;
  margin-top: 6px;
  color: #8a5705;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}

.verificationLink {
  margin-top: 10px;
  color: #8a5705;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}

.accountIdentity {
  margin: auto 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.signOutButton {
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.sidebar .wellnessNote {
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.diaryDashboard {
  width: min(1240px, 100%);
}

.diaryHeader {
  align-items: center;
}

.dateNavigator {
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 34px;
  border: 0;
}

.dateNavigator label {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
}

.diaryGroupSettingsLauncher {
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.diaryGroupSettings {
  max-width: 860px;
  padding: 24px;
  margin-top: 16px;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 16px;
}

.diaryGroupSettings h2,
.diaryGroupSettings p {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.diaryGroupSettings form {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.diaryGroupList {
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  list-style: none;
}

.diaryGroupList li {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.diaryGroupList label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.diaryGroupList input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 33, 29, 0.3);
  border-radius: 9px;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.diaryGroupList small {
  display: block;
  margin: 7px 0 12px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.diaryGroupSettings button:focus-visible,
.diaryGroupSettings input:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #4c8c65;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.diaryStatus {
  min-height: 22px;
  margin: 20px 0;
}

.todayOverview {
  margin: 30px 0 12px;
}

.todayOverviewHeading p,
.todayOverviewHeading h2 {
  margin: 0;
}

.todayOverviewHeading h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
}

.todayOverviewGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.todayOverviewCard {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 22px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 16px;
}

.todayOverviewCard[data-state="error"] {
  border-color: rgba(138, 51, 43, 0.45);
}

.todayOverviewCard header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
}

.todayOverviewCard h3,
.todayOverviewCard p {
  margin: 0;
}

.todayOverviewCard h3 {
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}

.todayOverviewCard a {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  color: var(--forest);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}

.todayOverviewBody {
  min-height: 82px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.todayOverviewMetric {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.todayOverviewMetric strong {
  font-size: 2rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
}

.todayOverviewBody > p + p {
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.todayOverviewError p {
  color: #8a332b;
}

.todayOverviewError button {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.todayOverviewCard a:focus-visible,
.todayOverviewCard button:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #4c8c65;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.diaryPageCount {
  margin: -10px 0 14px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.diaryLoadMore {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  margin-top: 24px;
}

.diaryLoadMore button:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #4c8c65;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.diaryLoadMore button[aria-disabled="true"] {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.68;
}

.diaryGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(280px, 0.42fr);
  gap: 30px;
  align-items: start;
}

.mealSection {
  margin-top: 34px;
}

.mealHeading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
}

.mealHeading h2,
.nutritionSummary h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
}

.mealHeading a {
  color: var(--forest);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}

.mealSection ul {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  list-style: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.mealSection li {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.emptyMeal {
  padding: 14px 0;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.diaryEntry {
  padding: 18px 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
}

.diaryEntry h3,
.diaryEntry p {
  margin: 0;
}

.diaryEntry p,
.diaryEntry small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.entryNote {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-left: 10px;
  border-left: 3px solid rgba(20, 60, 47, 0.22);
}

.diaryEntry .entryNote p {
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: var(--ink);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.diaryEntry small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.entryActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 7px;
}

.entryActions .dangerAction {
  color: #8a332b;
  border-color: rgba(138, 51, 43, 0.4);
}

.entryEditor {
  padding: 18px 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 9px 14px;
}

.entryEditor textarea {
  min-height: 96px;
  resize: vertical;
}

.entryEditor label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.entryEditor .entryNoteField,
.entryEditor .entryNoteHint,
.entryEditor .entryTimeHint {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.entryEditor .entryNoteHint {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.entryEditor .entryActions {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.nutritionSummary {
  position: sticky;
  top: 28px;
  padding: 26px;
  margin-top: 34px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 18px;
}

.nutritionSummary dl {
  margin: 20px 0 0;
}

.nutrientTotal {
  padding: 11px 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.nutrientTotal dt,
.nutrientTotal dd {
  margin: 0;
}

.nutrientTotal dd {
  font-weight: 800;
  text-align: right;
}

.nutrientTotal small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.totalsNote,
.lockedNotice {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
}

.lockedNotice {
  padding: 12px;
  background: #f7e6b0;
  border-radius: 9px;
}

.quickAddControls {
  padding: 16px;
  margin-top: 26px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 0;
}

.quickAddControls label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 5px;
}

.authCard form label,
.entryEditor label,
.quickAddControls label {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.quickAddControls a {
  padding: 11px;
  color: var(--forest);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.addStatus {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
}

.quickAddButton {
  justify-self: end;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.58;
}

.authCard button:focus-visible,
.authCard input:focus-visible,
.dateNavigator button:focus-visible,
.dateNavigator input:focus-visible,
.entryActions button:focus-visible,
.entryEditor input:focus-visible,
.entryEditor textarea:focus-visible,
.entryEditor select:focus-visible,
.quickAddControls input:focus-visible,
.quickAddControls select:focus-visible,
.quickAddButton:focus-visible,
.signOutButton:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #4c8c65;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.recipesDashboard,
.goalsDashboard {
  width: min(1240px, 100%);
}

.workspaceIntro {
  max-width: 780px;
  margin: 20px 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.recipeWorkspace,
.goalWorkspace {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(250px, 0.34fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 28px;
  margin-top: 42px;
  align-items: start;
}

.recipeRail,
.workspacePanel {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 20px;
}

.recipeRail {
  padding: 18px;
  background: var(--paper);
}

.workspacePanel {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 42px);
  background: var(--white);
}

.workspaceHeading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
}

.workspaceHeading h2,
.workspaceSection h3 {
  margin: 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.workspaceHeading h2 {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
  line-height: 1;
}

.goalEditorFields {
  border: 0;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.recipeList,
.ingredientList,
.warningList,
.progressList {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.recipeList button {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 13px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}

.recipeList button[aria-current="true"] {
  background: var(--white);
}

.recipeList button strong,
.recipeList button small {
  display: block;
}

.recipeList button small {
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.workspaceForm,
.goalTargetGrid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.workspaceForm {
  margin-top: 28px;
}

.formGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.formField {
  min-width: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.formField--wide {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.formField > span,
.fieldLegend {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.formField input,
.formField select,
.formField textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 33, 29, 0.3);
  border-radius: 9px;
  font: inherit;
}

.formField textarea {
  min-height: 88px;
  resize: vertical;
}

.fieldHelp,
.workspaceStatus,
.coverageCopy,
.sourceLine {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.workspaceStatus {
  min-height: 22px;
  margin: 14px 0 0;
}

.workspaceStatus[data-state="error"] {
  color: #8a332b;
}

.workspaceSection {
  padding-top: 28px;
  margin-top: 30px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.ingredientSearchResults {
  max-height: 340px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.ingredientResult,
.ingredientRow,
.goalTargetRow {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
}

.ingredientResult {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 13px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.ingredientResult > div:first-child {
  flex: 1 1 14rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.ingredientResult > div + div {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.ingredientResult > button,
.ingredientResult > div + div {
  max-width: 100%;
}

.myFoodPickerActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.myFoodPickerActions > a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  max-width: 100%;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ingredientResult + .ingredientResult,
.ingredientRow + .ingredientRow,
.goalTargetRow + .goalTargetRow {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.ingredientResult p,
.ingredientRow p {
  margin: 2px 0;
}

.ingredientRow {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 15px 0;
}

.ingredientRow > div:first-child {
  flex: 1 1 14rem;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.ingredientRow > .formField {
  flex: 0 1 7.5rem;
}

.goalTargetRow {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 9rem), 1fr));
  padding: 14px 0;
}

.goalTargetRow > * {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.goalTargetRow > div:first-child {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.goalTargetRow input {
  width: 100%;
}

.ingredientRow input,
.goalTargetRow input {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font: inherit;
}

.buttonPrimary,
.buttonSecondary,
.buttonQuiet,
.buttonDanger {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
````

````typescript
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import {
  proxyActivityChange,
  proxyActivityCreate,
  proxyActivityGet,
} from "../app/api/activities/proxy";
import { SESSION_COOKIE } from "./private-api";

const token = "t".repeat(43);
const ownerUserId = "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
const activityDayEtag = `"a-${"a".repeat(43)}"`;
const operationId = globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
const entry = {
  id: "3bcfa2bf-4950-43f7-9f24-b983ac803012",
  revision: "2",
  name: "Trail run",
  durationMinutes: 35,
  selfReportedEnergyKilocalories: "248.5",
  occurredAt: "2026-08-15T13:05:01.000Z",
  localDate: "2026-08-15",
  localTime: "08:05:01",
  timeZone: "America/Chicago",
  createdAt: "2026-08-15T13:05:02.000Z",
} as const;

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  vi.unstubAllEnvs();
});

function privateHeaders(extra: Record<string, string> = {}): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    cookie: `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${token}`,
    "x-expected-owner-user-id": ownerUserId,
    ...extra,
  };
}

function mutationHeaders(extra: Record<string, string> = {}): Record<string, string> {
  return privateHeaders({
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "idempotency-key": operationId,
    origin: "https://app.example.test",
    "sec-fetch-site": "same-origin",
    ...extra,
  });
}

function mutationData(changedEntry = entry) {
  return {
    data: {
      replayed: false,
      entry: changedEntry,
      affectedDays: [{ localDate: changedEntry.localDate, revision: "3" }],
    },
  };
}

describe("web activity read proxy", () => {
  it("forwards one local date to the plural route and preserves the exact ETag", async () => {
    const calls: Array<{ readonly url: string; readonly init?: RequestInit }> = [];
    vi.stubGlobal(
      "fetch",
      vi.fn(async (url: URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
        calls.push({ url: url.href, ...(init ? { init } : {}) });
        return Response.json(
          {
            data: {
              localDate: "2026-08-15",
              timeZone: "America/Chicago",
              revision: "3",
              entries: [entry],
              totalDurationMinutes: 35,
              updatedAt: "2026-08-15T13:05:02.000Z",
            },
          },
          { headers: { etag: activityDayEtag } },
        );
      }),
    );
    const response = await proxyActivityGet(
      new Request("https://app.example.test/api/activities?date=2026-08-15", {
        headers: privateHeaders(),
      }),
    );
    expect(calls[0]?.url).toBe("http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/activities?date=2026-08-15");
    expect(new Headers(calls[0]?.init?.headers).get("authorization")).toBe(`Bearer ${token}`);
    expect(new Headers(calls[0]?.init?.headers).get("x-expected-owner-user-id")).toBe(ownerUserId);
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.headers.get("cache-control")).toContain("no-store");
    expect(response.headers.get("etag")).toBe(activityDayEtag);
    expect(await response.json()).toMatchObject({ data: { totalDurationMinutes: 35 } });
  });

  it("rejects extra query keys, mismatched days, and malformed ETags", async () => {
    const fetcher = vi.fn(async () =>
      Response.json(
        {
          data: {
            localDate: "2026-08-16",
            timeZone: "America/Chicago",
            revision: "0",
            entries: [],
            totalDurationMinutes: 0,
            updatedAt: null,
          },
        },
        { headers: { etag: '"0"' } },
      ),
    );
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetcher);
    const invalid = await proxyActivityGet(
      new Request("https://app.example.test/api/activities?date=2026-08-15&goal=30", {
        headers: privateHeaders(),
      }),
    );
    expect(invalid.status).toBe(400);
    expect(fetcher).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const malformed = await proxyActivityGet(
      new Request("https://app.example.test/api/activities?date=2026-08-15", {
        headers: privateHeaders(),
      }),
    );
    expect(malformed.status).toBe(502);
    expect(malformed.headers.get("etag")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("web activity mutation proxy", () => {
  it("forwards a strict create with the required nullable energy and zone guard", async () => {
    const calls: Array<{ readonly url: string; readonly init?: RequestInit }> = [];
    vi.stubGlobal(
      "fetch",
      vi.fn(async (url: URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
        calls.push({ url: url.href, ...(init ? { init } : {}) });
        return Response.json(mutationData(), { status: 201 });
      }),
    );
    const body = {
      name: "Trail run",
````

````typescript
import { isLocalDate, localDateInTimeZone } from "./diary";

export const ACTIVITY_NAME_MAX_CODE_POINTS = 120;
export const ACTIVITY_NAME_MAX_UTF8_BYTES = 480;
export const ACTIVITY_DURATION_MAX_MINUTES = 1_440;
export const ACTIVITY_DAY_MAX_ENTRIES = 64;
export const ACTIVITY_DAY_MAX_DURATION_MINUTES =
  ACTIVITY_DURATION_MAX_MINUTES * ACTIVITY_DAY_MAX_ENTRIES;
export const ACTIVITY_ENERGY_MAX_KILOCALORIES = "20000";

export interface ActivityEntry {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly revision: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly durationMinutes: number;
  readonly selfReportedEnergyKilocalories: string | null;
  readonly occurredAt: string;
  readonly localDate: string;
  readonly localTime: string;
  readonly timeZone: string;
  readonly createdAt: string;
}

export interface ActivityDay {
  readonly localDate: string;
  readonly timeZone: string;
  readonly revision: string;
  readonly entries: readonly ActivityEntry[];
  readonly totalDurationMinutes: number;
  readonly updatedAt: string | null;
}

export interface ActivityMutation {
  readonly replayed: boolean;
  readonly entry: ActivityEntry | null;
  readonly affectedDays: readonly { readonly localDate: string; readonly revision: string }[];
}

export interface ActivityCreateBody {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly durationMinutes: number;
  readonly selfReportedEnergyKilocalories: string | null;
  readonly occurredAt: string;
}

export interface ActivityUpdateBody {
  readonly name?: string;
  readonly durationMinutes?: number;
  readonly selfReportedEnergyKilocalories?: string | null;
  readonly occurredAt?: string;
}

const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/iu;
const REVISION = /^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$/u;
const POSITIVE_REVISION = /^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$/u;
const LOCAL_TIME = /^(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9](?:\.\d{1,3})?$/u;
const RFC3339 =
  /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9](?:\.\d{1,9})?(?:Z|[+-](?:(?:0[0-9]|1[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]|14:00))$/u;
const OCCURRED_AT =
  /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9](?:\.\d{1,3})?(?:Z|[+-](?:(?:0[0-9]|1[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]|14:00))$/u;
const ENERGY_DRAFT = /^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,4})(?:\.[0-9]{1,3})?$/u;

function record(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function exactKeys(value: Record<string, unknown>, expected: readonly string[]): boolean {
  const actual = Object.keys(value).sort();
  const sorted = [...expected].sort();
  return actual.length === sorted.length && actual.every((key, index) => key === sorted[index]);
}

function onlyPairedSurrogates(value: string): boolean {
  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
    const codeUnit = value.charCodeAt(index);
    if (codeUnit >= 0xd800 && codeUnit <= 0xdbff) {
      const next = value.charCodeAt(index + 1);
      if (!(next >= 0xdc00 && next <= 0xdfff)) return false;
      index += 1;
    } else if (codeUnit >= 0xdc00 && codeUnit <= 0xdfff) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

export function canonicalActivityNameFromDraft(value: string): string {
  if (/\p{Cc}/u.test(value) || !onlyPairedSurrogates(value)) {
    throw new RangeError("Activity name cannot contain control characters.");
  }
  const normalized = value.normalize("NFC").trim().replace(/\s+/gu, " ");
  if (
    normalized.length === 0 ||
    [...normalized].length > ACTIVITY_NAME_MAX_CODE_POINTS ||
    new TextEncoder().encode(normalized).length > ACTIVITY_NAME_MAX_UTF8_BYTES
  ) {
    throw new RangeError("Enter an activity name from 1 to 120 characters.");
  }
  return normalized;
}

export function activityDurationFromDraft(value: string): number {
  if (!/^[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$/u.test(value)) {
    throw new RangeError("Enter whole minutes from 1 to 1,440.");
  }
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < 1 || parsed > ACTIVITY_DURATION_MAX_MINUTES) {
    throw new RangeError("Enter whole minutes from 1 to 1,440.");
  }
  return parsed;
}

export function activityEnergyFromDraft(value: string): string | null {
  if (value.trim() === "") return null;
  if (!ENERGY_DRAFT.test(value)) {
    throw new RangeError("Enter up to 20,000 calories with no more than 3 decimal places.");
  }
  const [whole = "0", rawFraction = ""] = value.split(".");
  const scaled = BigInt(whole) * 1_000n + BigInt(rawFraction.padEnd(3, "0"));
  if (scaled < 1n || scaled > 20_000_000n) {
    throw new RangeError("Enter up to 20,000 calories with no more than 3 decimal places.");
  }
  const fraction = rawFraction.replace(/0+$/u, "");
  return fraction ? `${whole}.${fraction}` : whole;
}

function canonicalActivityName(value: unknown): value is string {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return false;
  try {
    return canonicalActivityNameFromDraft(value) === value;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function activityDuration(value: unknown): value is number {
  return (
    Number.isSafeInteger(value) &&
    Number(value) >= 1 &&
    Number(value) <= ACTIVITY_DURATION_MAX_MINUTES
  );
}

function canonicalActivityEnergy(value: unknown): value is string {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return false;
  try {
    return activityEnergyFromDraft(value) === value;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function revision(value: unknown, positive = false): value is string {
  return (
    typeof value === "string" &&
    (positive ? POSITIVE_REVISION : REVISION).test(value) &&
    BigInt(value) <= 9_223_372_036_854_775_807n
  );
}

function timestamp(value: unknown): value is string {
  return (
    typeof value === "string" &&
    value.length <= 64 &&
    RFC3339.test(value) &&
    isLocalDate(value.slice(0, 10)) &&
    Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value))
  );
}

function occurredAt(value: unknown): value is string {
  return timestamp(value) && OCCURRED_AT.test(value);
}

function canonicalTimeZone(value: unknown): value is string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 1 || value.length > 63) return false;
  try {
    return (
      new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: value }).resolvedOptions().timeZone === value
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function localTimeForInstant(instant: Date, timeZone: string): string {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US-u-ca-iso8601-nu-latn", {
    timeZone,
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23",
  }).formatToParts(instant);
  const values = new Map(parts.map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
  const hour = values.get("hour");
  const minute = values.get("minute");
  const second = values.get("second");
  if (!hour || !minute || !second) return "";
  const milliseconds = instant.getUTCMilliseconds();
  return `${hour}:${minute}:${second}${
    milliseconds === 0 ? "" : `.${milliseconds.toString().padStart(3, "0")}`
  }`;
}

function activityCoordinatesMatch(value: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  if (
    typeof value.occurredAt !== "string" ||
    typeof value.localDate !== "string" ||
    typeof value.localTime !== "string" ||
    typeof value.timeZone !== "string"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  const instant = new Date(value.occurredAt);
  return (
    localDateInTimeZone(instant, value.timeZone) === value.localDate &&
    localTimeForInstant(instant, value.timeZone) === value.localTime
  );
}

export function parseActivityEntry(value: unknown): ActivityEntry {
  if (
    !record(value) ||
    !exactKeys(value, [
      "id",
      "revision",
      "name",
      "durationMinutes",
      "selfReportedEnergyKilocalories",
      "occurredAt",
      "localDate",
      "localTime",
      "timeZone",
      "createdAt",
    ]) ||
    typeof value.id !== "string" ||
    !UUID.test(value.id) ||
    !revision(value.revision, true) ||
    !canonicalActivityName(value.name) ||
    !activityDuration(value.durationMinutes) ||
    !(
      value.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories === null ||
      canonicalActivityEnergy(value.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories)
    ) ||
    !occurredAt(value.occurredAt) ||
    !isLocalDate(value.localDate) ||
    typeof value.localTime !== "string" ||
    !LOCAL_TIME.test(value.localTime) ||
    !canonicalTimeZone(value.timeZone) ||
    !timestamp(value.createdAt) ||
    !activityCoordinatesMatch(value)
  ) {
    throw new TypeError("An activity entry was invalid.");
  }
  return value as unknown as ActivityEntry;
}

function activityEntriesAreOrdered(entries: readonly ActivityEntry[]): boolean {
  return entries.every((entry, index) => {
    const previous = entries[index - 1];
    return (
      !previous ||
      previous.occurredAt < entry.occurredAt ||
      (previous.occurredAt === entry.occurredAt && previous.id < entry.id)
    );
  });
}

export function parseActivityDay(value: unknown): ActivityDay {
  if (!record(value) || !exactKeys(value, ["data"]) || !record(value.data)) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity response envelope was invalid.");
  }
  const data = value.data;
  if (
    !exactKeys(data, [
      "localDate",
      "timeZone",
      "revision",
      "entries",
      "totalDurationMinutes",
      "updatedAt",
    ]) ||
    !isLocalDate(data.localDate) ||
    !canonicalTimeZone(data.timeZone) ||
    !revision(data.revision) ||
    !Array.isArray(data.entries) ||
    data.entries.length > ACTIVITY_DAY_MAX_ENTRIES ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(data.totalDurationMinutes) ||
    Number(data.totalDurationMinutes) < 0 ||
    Number(data.totalDurationMinutes) > ACTIVITY_DAY_MAX_DURATION_MINUTES ||
    !(data.updatedAt === null || timestamp(data.updatedAt))
  ) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity day was invalid.");
  }
  const entries = data.entries.map(parseActivityEntry);
  if (
    new Set(entries.map((entry) => entry.id)).size !== entries.length ||
    !activityEntriesAreOrdered(entries) ||
    entries.some((entry) => entry.localDate !== data.localDate) ||
    entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.durationMinutes, 0) !== data.totalDurationMinutes ||
    (data.updatedAt === null &&
      (data.revision !== "0" || entries.length !== 0 || data.totalDurationMinutes !== 0))
  ) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity day was inconsistent.");
  }
  return {
    localDate: data.localDate,
    timeZone: data.timeZone,
    revision: data.revision,
    entries,
    totalDurationMinutes: data.totalDurationMinutes,
    updatedAt: data.updatedAt,
  };
}

export function parseActivityMutation(value: unknown): ActivityMutation {
  if (!record(value) || !exactKeys(value, ["data"]) || !record(value.data)) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity mutation envelope was invalid.");
  }
  const data = value.data;
  if (
    !exactKeys(data, ["replayed", "entry", "affectedDays"]) ||
    typeof data.replayed !== "boolean" ||
    !Array.isArray(data.affectedDays) ||
    data.affectedDays.length < 1 ||
    data.affectedDays.length > 2
  ) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity mutation was invalid.");
  }
  const affectedDays = data.affectedDays.map((item) => {
    if (
      !record(item) ||
      !exactKeys(item, ["localDate", "revision"]) ||
      !isLocalDate(item.localDate) ||
      !revision(item.revision, true)
    ) {
      throw new TypeError("An activity mutation day was invalid.");
    }
    return { localDate: item.localDate, revision: item.revision };
  });
  if (new Set(affectedDays.map((item) => item.localDate)).size !== affectedDays.length) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity mutation days were duplicated.");
  }
  return {
    replayed: data.replayed,
    entry: data.entry === null ? null : parseActivityEntry(data.entry),
    affectedDays,
  };
}

export function parseActivityCreateBody(value: unknown): ActivityCreateBody {
  if (
    !record(value) ||
    !exactKeys(value, [
      "name",
      "durationMinutes",
      "selfReportedEnergyKilocalories",
      "occurredAt",
    ]) ||
    !canonicalActivityName(value.name) ||
    !activityDuration(value.durationMinutes) ||
    !(
      value.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories === null ||
      canonicalActivityEnergy(value.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories)
    ) ||
    !occurredAt(value.occurredAt)
  ) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity entry request was invalid.");
  }
  return value as unknown as ActivityCreateBody;
}

export function parseActivityUpdateBody(value: unknown): ActivityUpdateBody {
  if (
    !record(value) ||
    Object.keys(value).length < 1 ||
    Object.keys(value).length > 4 ||
    Object.keys(value).some(
      (key) =>
        key !== "name" &&
        key !== "durationMinutes" &&
        key !== "selfReportedEnergyKilocalories" &&
        key !== "occurredAt",
    ) ||
    ("name" in value && !canonicalActivityName(value.name)) ||
    ("durationMinutes" in value && !activityDuration(value.durationMinutes)) ||
    ("selfReportedEnergyKilocalories" in value &&
      !(
        value.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories === null ||
        canonicalActivityEnergy(value.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories)
      )) ||
    ("occurredAt" in value && !occurredAt(value.occurredAt))
  ) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity entry update was invalid.");
  }
  return value as ActivityUpdateBody;
}

export type ActivityMutationExpectation =
  | {
      readonly kind: "create";
      readonly sourceLocalDate: string;
      readonly request: ActivityCreateBody;
    }
  | {
      readonly kind: "update";
      readonly entryId: string;
      readonly sourceLocalDate: string;
      readonly request: ActivityUpdateBody;
    }
  | {
      readonly kind: "delete";
      readonly entryId: string;
      readonly sourceLocalDate: string;
    };

/** Validate mutation meaning against the browser's exact request, not only its envelope shape. */
export function assertActivityMutationSemantics(
  mutation: ActivityMutation,
  expectation: ActivityMutationExpectation,
): void {
  if (!isLocalDate(expectation.sourceLocalDate)) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity mutation expectation was invalid.");
  }
  if (expectation.kind === "delete") {
    if (
      mutation.entry !== null ||
      mutation.affectedDays.length !== 1 ||
      mutation.affectedDays[0]?.localDate !== expectation.sourceLocalDate
    ) {
      throw new TypeError("The activity delete response was inconsistent.");
    }
    return;
  }
  const entry = mutation.entry;
  if (!entry || (expectation.kind === "update" && entry.id !== expectation.entryId)) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity mutation returned the wrong entry.");
  }
  for (const [key, requested] of Object.entries(expectation.request)) {
    if (entry[key as keyof ActivityEntry] !== requested) {
      throw new TypeError("The activity mutation did not match the requested fields.");
    }
  }
  const expectedDates =
    expectation.kind === "create"
      ? [entry.localDate]
      : [...new Set([expectation.sourceLocalDate, entry.localDate])].sort();
  const actualDates = mutation.affectedDays.map((item) => item.localDate).sort();
  if (
    expectation.sourceLocalDate !==
      (expectation.kind === "create" ? entry.localDate : expectation.sourceLocalDate) ||
    actualDates.length !== expectedDates.length ||
    actualDates.some((value, index) => value !== expectedDates[index])
  ) {
    throw new TypeError("The activity mutation returned inconsistent affected days.");
  }
}

export function activityEntryAccessibilityLabel(entry: ActivityEntry): string {
  const energy = entry.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories
    ? `, ${entry.selfReportedEnergyKilocalories} self-reported kilocalories`
    : ", no calorie estimate";
  return `${entry.name}, ${entry.durationMinutes.toLocaleString("en-US")} minutes${energy}, at ${entry.localTime.slice(0, 5)}.`;
}
````

## File: apps/web/src/lib/content-security.ts
````typescript
export function contentSecurityPolicy(nonce: string, production: boolean): string {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{16,128}$/u.test(nonce)) throw new TypeError("Invalid CSP nonce.");
  return [
    "default-src 'self'",
    "base-uri 'self'",
    "connect-src 'self'",
    "font-src 'self' data:",
    "form-action 'self'",
    "frame-ancestors 'none'",
    "img-src 'self' data: blob:",
    "object-src 'none'",
    `script-src 'self' 'nonce-${nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'${production ? "" : " 'unsafe-eval'"}`,
    "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'",
    "upgrade-insecure-requests",
  ].join("; ");
}
````

````typescript
    expect(dailyOverviewRequestMatches(expected, { ...expected, localDate: "2026-08-16" })).toBe(

        expected,
        current,
        revalidatedSession,
        response: loaded.response,
      }),
    );

    current = { ...expected, localDate: "2026-08-16", requestGeneration: 12 };
    delayed.resolve({

    await expect(result).resolves.toBe("stale");

    expect(
      dailyOverviewFence({
        expected,
        current: expected,
        revalidatedSession: { ...revalidatedSession, user: { id: "owner-b" } },

    expect(
      dailyOverviewFence({

        current: expected,
        revalidatedSession: {
          ...revalidatedSession,
          profile: { ...revalidatedSession.profile, revision: "8" },

        response,

        revalidatedSession: {
          ...revalidatedSession,
          profile: { ...revalidatedSession.profile, timeZone: "America/New_York" },
        },
        response,
      }),
    ).toBe("profile-changed");
    expect(

        expected,
        current: expected,
        revalidatedSession,
        response: { ...response, localDate: "2026-08-16" },
      }),
    ).toBe("response-mismatch");
    expect(

        expected,
        current: expected,
        revalidatedSession,
        response: { ...response, timeZone: "America/New_York" },
      }),
    ).toBe("response-mismatch");
  });

  it("closes private UI on either endpoint's 401 and the activity owner conflict only", () => {
    expect(dailyOverviewRequiresPrivateUiClosure("hydration", 401, null)).toBe(true);

      false,

  });
});
````
