## File: SECURITY.md
````markdown
# Security Policy

This project is pre-release. Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to the
repository owner; do not include health data, access tokens, credentials, or
proof-of-concept data from another person in an issue.

This standalone repository does not have a remote or staffed disclosure address
yet. Before any public deployment, the owner must enable GitHub private
vulnerability reporting (or publish a monitored security address here) and test
that route. Until then, this missing channel is a launch blocker—not permission
to file sensitive details publicly.

The application must treat food diaries, biometrics, integration tokens, exports,
and free-text notes as sensitive. Security reports are acknowledged and triaged
before feature work. No public vulnerability bounty or response-time promise is
made until a staffed disclosure process exists.
````

## File: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
````markdown
# Third-Party Notices

This inventory is a release gate, not a substitute for the license text shipped
with each dependency or dataset. The lockfile and source manifests are the
auditable record of the exact versions used.

## Application dependencies

The initial foundation uses permissively licensed tools including TypeScript,
Fastify, Next.js, React, React Native/Expo, Kysely, Vitest, Biome, and supporting
packages. CI must regenerate and review the production dependency license list
before a release.

The initial dependency graph also contains reviewed transitive exceptions:
platform sharp/libvips binaries under LGPL-3.0-or-later, unmodified
`lightningcss` components under MPL-2.0, and `caniuse-lite` data under CC-BY-4.0.
Their notice, attribution, source/relinking, and modification obligations remain
a release gate; the automated policy is recorded in `config/license-policy.json`.

## Food data

- USDA FoodData Central: public-domain/CC0 source; attribution is retained as a
  product trust and provenance requirement.
- Canadian Nutrient File: use is conditional on the exact release terms recorded
  in `data/manifests/cnf.json` and approval before ingestion.
- Open Food Facts: ODbL data must remain behind the documented isolated boundary;
  it is not part of the initial canonical store without legal review.
- Cronometer CRDB, CFCD, copy, assets, and proprietary data are not inputs.

## Release rule

No dependency, dataset, model, font, image, or copied text may enter a release
without a version, source, license classification, and owner in the provenance
inventory.
````

        "ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_WRITE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
        "ERASURE_REPLAY_LEDGER_WRITE_SESSION_TOKEN",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_BUCKET",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_CURRENT_KEY_ID",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_DELETE_VERSION_POLICY",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_DIRECTORY",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_ENCRYPTION_KEYS",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_ENDPOINT",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_REGION",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_STORE",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_WRITE_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_WRITE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
        "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_WRITE_SESSION_TOKEN",
        "LOG_LEVEL",
        "MEILI_ADMIN_KEY",
        "MEILI_TASK_OBSERVER_KEY",
        "MEILI_URL",
        "NODE_ENV",
        "POLL_INTERVAL_MS",
        "RETENTION_EXPORT_SPOOL_DIR",
        "RETENTION_EXPORT_SPOOL_MAX_AGE_MS",
        "RETENTION_EXPORT_SPOOL_MAX_BYTES",
        "RETENTION_EXPORT_SPOOL_PROTECTION",
        "RETENTION_FEATURES_ENABLED",
        "RETENTION_WORKER_ID",
        "SEARCH_REBUILD_BATCH_SIZE",
        "SEARCH_REBUILD_EVENT_BATCH_SIZE",
        "SEARCH_REBUILD_SPOOL_DIR",
        "SEARCH_REBUILD_SPOOL_MAX_BYTES",

        "SEARCH_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS",
        "SEARCH_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS",
        "SERVICE_VERSION",
        "SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS"
      ],
      "persistent": true,
      "with": [
        "@nutrition-tracker/artifact-store#dev",
        "@nutrition-tracker/contracts#dev",
        "@nutrition-tracker/db#dev",
        "@nutrition-tracker/domain#dev",
        "@nutrition-tracker/search#dev"
      ]
    },
    "@nutrition-tracker/web#dev": {
      "cache": false,
      "interruptible": true,
      "passThroughEnv": ["API_INTERNAL_URL", "WEB_PUBLIC_ORIGIN"],
      "persistent": true
    },
    "@nutrition-tracker/mobile#dev": {
      "cache": false,
      "interruptible": true,
      "passThroughEnv": ["EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL"],
      "persistent": true
    },
    "@nutrition-tracker/mobile#build": {
      "dependsOn": ["^build"],
      "env": ["EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL"],
      "outputs": ["dist/**"]
    },
    "@nutrition-tracker/web#build": {
      "dependsOn": ["^build"],
      "env": ["API_INTERNAL_URL", "WEB_PUBLIC_ORIGIN"],
      "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**"]
    },
    "lint": {
      "dependsOn": ["^lint"]
    },
    "test": {
      "dependsOn": ["^build"]
    },
    "typecheck": {
      "dependsOn": ["^build"]
    }
  }
}
